sg: Kozo ni ti tene a turugu a ga, Haïti a wara pkale ti kobela pepe na ya ti a ngu 1800.

en: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.
sg: Danielle Lantagne so a yeke mbeni wa bembe ngo do ti be ndo guigui na legue ti a kobela , a fa a tene a yeke a tourougou ti siriri la a yeke na gounda ti mboupa so.

en: NextGen is a system the FAA claims would allow aircraft to fly shorter routes and save millions of gallons of fuel each year and cut carbon emissions.
sg: NextGen ayeke mbeni ye so amu lêgë na alapara ti hon na nduru lêgë na ti sara kua na carburant mingui ape nay a ti ngu oko ye so asar si a tokua a sioni pupu mingui ape.

en: It uses satellite-based technology as opposed to older ground-radar-based technology to allow air traffic controllers to pinpoint aircraft with greater precision and give pilots more accurate information.
sg: Lo sara kua na kode so a luti na ndo ti satellite na lo kiè kode so a luti na ndo ti radar ti sêse ti mu lêgë na ala so ayeke bâa ndo ti a lapara ti fa ye na lêgë ni na ala so ayeke kpe na lapara.

en: No extra transport is being put on and overground trains will not stop at Wembley, and car parking and park-and-ride facilities are unavailable at the ground.
sg: Aza na sêse mbeni lêgë ti hongo na ni ape, na a train ti le ti nduzu ayeke luti na Wembley ape, na ndo so a kutukutu a luti da ayeke da ape.

en: Fears of lack of transportation raised the possibility that the game would be forced to play behind closed doors without the team's supporters.
sg: Mbeto ti tene akutukutu amanke a sara si a hunda ti tene a pika ndembo ni na hondengo ni.

en: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported on formation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorean Galápagos Islands.
sg: Mbeni guingo nda ti ye afa so ambeni fini ndeke a sigi na mbâgë ti zoa ti Galapagos.

en: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported the new species evolved in just two generations, though this process had been believed to take much longer, due to breeding between an endemic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, and the immigrant cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.
sg: A zo ti gui nda ti aye na seda gui ti Princeton na ködörö ti America na ala ti seda gui ti Uppsala na ködörö ti Suede afa so mbeni fini maka ni a maï gui na popo ti a generation use ahon kwe so a mu ngoï mingui ndali ti so dou ngo ni na popo ti pinson ti Darwin, Geospiza fortes et le cactus so lo maï, pinson, Geospiza conirostris.

en: Gold may be worked into all sorts of shapes. It can be rolled into tiny shapes.
sg: A lingbi ti sara si or a mu a forme nde. A peut ti roulé lo kete.

en: It can be pulled into thin wire, which can be twisted and plaited. It can be hammered or rolled into sheets.
sg: A lingbi ti sara ti tene loga kete kamba so agbe na pete. A peut ti pika lo ti ga plat wala ti roulé tongana kougbe.

en: It can be made very thin, and stuck onto other metal. It can be made so thin that it was sometimes used to decorate the hand-painted pictures in books called "illuminated manuscripts".
sg: A lingbi ti sara si lo ga kete na a colé lo na ndo ti wen. A sara si lo ga kete si aza lo na ndo ti a foto so asara na mbamba na maboko na ya ti a buku so a iri ni “manuscrits éluminés”.

en: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.
sg: A yeke ye so a saran a kua ti hinga si mbeni ya ayeke acide wala pëpe.. A lingbi ti sara kua na jus ti bengba chou.

en: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
sg: Ngu ti kougbe ti chou agbian tere ti lo na ngoi so aza lo naya ti acide.

en: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.
sg: A yeke hinga si ngu ni ayeke acide na wungo ti a ions htdrogèen so a za da.

en: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
sg: Na ya ti hydrogène mo yeke wara proton na electron, a ion ayeke a proton so azi a electron na ya ni awe.

en: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.
sg: Yengere a fuku use so ahule lêgë oko, na peko ni bîrîngi ala na maboko.

en: The moisture on your hands will react with the outer layers, which will feel funny and form a sort of shell.
sg: Tongana maboko adë mbeni sensation nde ayeke bâa gigi so a kpa coquille .

en: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.
sg: Na ya ti ada na Harapa nga na Mohenjo-daro a douche ayeke na toilette so agboto ngu da.

en: Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.
sg: A wara nay â ti ada atanga ti aye so a wara na ya ti a fungo ngu na ködörö ti a minoen na Crète na Santorin na ködörö ti Grèce.

en: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.
sg: A wara a toilette na yâ ti Egypte ti giriri, na Perse nga na Chine. Na ya ti sarango ye ti a romain, a toilette ni a koli na awali kue a sukula ngu da lêgë oko.

en: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
sg: Tongana mo iri mbeni zo so ayo a kilomètre saki mingui, mo yeke sara kua na satellite la.

en: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.
sg: Satellite a wara iringo ndo ni na lê ti nduzu na lo tokua ni na sêse, na oko ngoi ni.

en: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth’s atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.
sg: Mbeni fusée la atokua satellite ni na nduzu. Azo ti senda ye a sara kua na telescope na lê ti nduzu ndali ti so pupu so angoro sêse. a sara si bango ndo ni ayeke nzoni ape.

en: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.
sg: A lingbi a mû kota fusée ti tene a tokua satellite wala telescope ni brace 100 na nduzu.

en: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.
sg: Gêrë ti oto ni a sara si dunia kue a gbian na mbeni lêgë so ado bê.Kota ye so gêrë to oto asara na i si a lêgë ti tambela ayapu na agwe iyo.

en: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.
sg: Lo ga na e train, kutukutu, na a lêgë ti tambela mingui.

en: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.
sg: Na gbe ti ala mo yeke wara a gnaou so akono mingui ape so a te a gnama so akono mingui ape so a londo na ndaramba ti si na dengbe nga na gandi.

en: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.
sg: Na nda ni, a yeke wara a kete gnaou(a gnaou so abata na da) so ate akete ye mingui tongana a kete gnama, a dekou, a kada nga na andeke.

en: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.
sg: Nda ti so ala maï alondo na ndara ti niche, kusara so ayeke nde si a mu lêgë na a gnaou ti aka tere ti ala na atangani ape.

en: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
sg: A bamara ayeke a nyâü so a lesongo mingui, ala duti ndo oko na groupe so a iri ni fierté.

en: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
sg: Na ya ti fierté a yeke wara koli ni oko wala use so apeut ti duti aita, na awali ni so aga nduru na bale ota nga na kete môlengê ti ours.

en: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
sg: A wali ni ayeke lakue nduru na amba ti ala, ala yeke mingi ni aita wala mama na môlengê.

en: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
sg: A fierté ti abamara ni ayeke tongana bungbi ti a gbongo wala ambô, a nyama so asarango ye ti ala akpa tere na ti a koli bamara( mais a kota gnaou ape), so ayeke sara gui sioni na amba ti ala angama.

en: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.
sg: Ngangu wa sara ngo madako, zè alingbi ti monté aye(mais nzoni ape), ti nagé, ti huru yongoro, na lo yô fani okou kungba so akoli ossi la apeut ti yô ni.

en: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.
sg: Zè ayeke na ya ti bungbi oko(Genre Panthera) na bamara na léopard nga na jaguar kue. Gi a Nyâü ossio so la ayeke na ngangu ti dekongo.

en: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.
sg: Dekongo ti zè ayeke tongana ti bamara ape, me ayeke mo baa mo tene mbeni zo so ayeke nangonzo la adekongo.

en: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.
sg: A ocelot aye mingui tite akete gnama. Ala peut ti gbu a dengbe, a ngbô, na a dekou tongana ala ye. A nyama so kue ocelot agbu ni ayeke kete ahon lo.

en: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.
sg: Azo ti senda ye atene so a ocelots awara agnaa tit e grace na ngangu ti ala ti mango fion ti ye, ala ma fion ti ndo so.

en: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
sg: Ala lingbi ti bâa do na bi na ti tambala sans ti tene a ma go ti gre ti ala. A ocelot awra akobe ti ala ti tengo ni na ondengo tere ti ala na hurungo na ndo ti.

en: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
sg: Tongana mbeni kete bungbi ti aye so ayeke na fini a kangbi tere na bungbi so lo yeke kä na ya ni ( tongana ala hon na ndo ti a kota hoto wala na ndo ti angu, wala ala londo ala gué na mbeni zoa ti kiri na peko ape) ala yeke wara tere lakue na mbeni ndo so ayeke nde na ti so ala yeke da kozo.

en: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
sg: Fini ndo so a yeke na aye mingui na amba ti ala kue yeke tiri ndali ni, a sara si ala yeke gui ti duti na ambeni fini sarango ye ti tene ala kue awara ndo ti duti da.

en: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.
sg: A nyama ti kozo ködörö ni a gbian sarango ye ti ala ape, ala yeke lakue na bezoin ti akozo sarango i ti ala.

en: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.
sg: Tongana ngoi ayeke hon, na tongana a nyama so aga na fini ni ayeke habitué na ndo ti ala, ala yeke sara ye mo ba mo tene ti kozo ape ala sara ye tongana ti so ayeke na fin indo ni.

en: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
sg: Na nda ni, peko ti angu saki mingui wala kutu mingi, bungbi ti a nyama ni use kue sarango ye ti ala ayeke duti ande gui nde.

en: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
sg: I iri ye ni so speciation, so afa ga ngo ti afini bungbi. Sarango ti tene mbeni fini bungbi ti aye aba gigi ayeke tene ti maï ngo ti aye.

en: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).
sg: A keke a yeke tokua apupu so azo ahu ni, na ala hu sioni pupu so azo atokua ni.

en: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.
sg: Akeke a wara ngangu na lêgë ti lâ. Alay eke sara si azo awara gbe ti dé.

en: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.
sg: E yeke mu akeke la e yeke sara ada ti i nga na abongo. Mingi ti akobe so e tè ayeke akeke. A nyama ayeke kui tongana akeke ni ayeke da ape.

en: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
sg: Mosasaurus a yeke a ndo kota prédateur ti ngoi ti lo, mbeto ti ye oko a sara lo pepe, gui ti a mba ti lo mosasaurus.

en: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
sg: A yongoro Ngbângbâ ti lo a yeke a ndo pasûndâ na zängö pembe 70 tongana lazüära na a mbeni pembi ni na ya ti yanga ti lo na nduzu, so a ye ti tene legue ti kpe ngo ni a yeke da ape, tene ti a zo so kue a tingbi na lo

en: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
sg: ë inga pepe na garatïi, wara lo yeke na mëngä so a ke gba ni. Na ya ti a ye so lo ke te ë ke wara kunda, kota sussu, a mbeni mosasaures, na lo lîngbi tî sâra ye tongana a watëngö-zo.

en: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
sg: Lo ga gaba ngâ na ndo ti a ye so kue a linda ngu, legue ôko kota dinosaure tongana T.rex a lingbi ti sara ye oko na dawäa ti lo pepe.

en: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse
sg: Andâa mingi ti a kobe ti ala a ga ti duti sëwä na e, azo ti Rome ayeke na a âkûngbâ ti ala ti matanga so ayeke kîrîkiri wara ti kpêne, tongana a mbëngë, a kürüngü, na nga mbeni mara ti a walitën so iri ni ayeke loir.

en: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.
sg: Mbeni ye so ayeke ndê na pöpö ni ayeke so wayërë na nga wali a duti na ndo ti ngendë na ngoi so ala ke te kobe, a koli ti mosoro a ye mingi sara matanga na popo ti ala wara ala prelasser na ndo ti kate ti ala na ngoi ti te ngo kobe ti ala.

en: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.
sg: Na a kobe ti a romains antiques a lingbi ti bumbi a kobe so a londo na Amérique wara na Asie na nga na poto tënë ti a ngûngbangbo ti ga.

en: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.
sg: Na tâpande, ala yeke lani na nzö, damâti, pumbutêre, kakaöo a pe , na nga Romain oko ti mbeso na tara wâlïdendöon ape.

en: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.
sg: A zo ti ködörö sêse ti Babylone a lekere zo oko ti a nzapa ti ala tö danzapä so a la bâa ni tongana da ti nzapa.

en: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.
sg: A zo ti ga na yê tî yändä na a nzapa na nga a buäa tara ti kiri na peko ti hunda ngo ndo ti ala na a nzapa na lêgë ti a matanga na ga na tögângbi

en: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.
sg: Danzapa oko oko ayeke na mbeni lendo so a zi polele, na ndo ti mokondö so ayeke na yani, so si gi abua a lingbi ti linda da.

en: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.
sg: A mbeni, ayeke na a tours ndê so a kpa pyramide, so iri ni ayeke ziggourats, na a lekere ni ti tënë a duti na ya ti popo terê ti danzapa ni.

en: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
sg: Li ti tour ni ayeke mbeni sanctuaire ndê tënë ti nzapa.

en: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.
sg: Na ya ti sêndo ti wa ti Moyen-Orient, da ni ayeke kota.

en: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.
sg: Kota mbagë ti gigi ti sëwä ti a hébraïque ayeke na ya ti pupu.

en: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.
sg: A wali so yeke to kobe na ya na gigi; a dangêrë ayeke gi na kondoäre so ayeke na ndo ti lêgë. A tênë ni ayeke ti sara ngo na a da.

en: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.
sg: A kota gbakô ayeke la ni da pe na ya ti ködörö sêse ti Canaan, keke ayeke na ngere ngangu.

en: Greenland was settled sparsely. In the Norse sagas they say that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when travelling further west, found Greenland and named it Greenland.
sg: Kodro ti Greenland ayeke na gba ti azo. Na ya ti Saga ti banga, ala tënë Erik the Red ayeke wakpëngö-ködörö ti ködörö sêse ti Islande tënë ti fango-zo, na tambula ngo mingi na mbage ti do, nila lo tingbi na Greenland, na lo za iri ti Greenland.

en: But regardless of his discovery, Eskimo tribes were already living there at the time.
sg: Kamême, si tene ti wara ngo ye so lo wara, a kêtê marä ti a esquimaudes ayeke na ndo ni la ni.

en: Though each country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, kings, customs and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.
sg: Nga si ködörö oko oko ‘scandinave ’, a ye ndê ayeke fade mingi na popo ti a zo ti ködörö, a gbia, a ngôbo ti sara ngo ye, a sêndâdünîa ti Danemark, ti Suède, ti Norvège na nga ti l'Islande.

en: If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.
sg: Wara ala bâa limo ti Tresor National, ala da bê ti ala na ndo ti kârâte ti nginza, so a sara mbeti na peko ti dëpä ti lipandäa.

en: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.
sg: Atâa, ayeke ta tënë pëpe. Atâa sô a sû mbeni ye na peko ti mbeti ni, a yeke kârâte ti nguinza pëpe

en: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.
sg: Na fade na peko ti depaa ti lipandäa a mbeni a mbeti ayeke da " Taa dëpä ti lipandäa, nze ti lêngoa 4 ngu 1776”. A sara mbeti ni na gbeti buku ni.

en: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.
sg: Na nga si zo ok a inga na lêgë ti ta tënë zo so a sara mbeti ni, a inga so na to nda ti gigi ti lo, kota buku so ( hakangö ti lo ayeke 29¾ kota limabôko na ndo ti 24½ kota limabôko) a ngô lo tene ti bata lo.

en: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.
sg: Na fade si a za notation so gi a yeke tongana senge têmbere.

en: The D-Day landings and the following battles had freed the north of France, but the south still wasn't free.
sg: züngö na a bira so a sara si a si France ti banga, mais ti mbongo ni a yeke yamba pëpe.

en: It was ruled by the "Vichy" French. These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders instead of fighting them.
sg: Lo yeke fade na gbeti lengo gbia ti a gbia Français ti “Vichy”. Ayeke fade a zo ti ködörö sêse ti France so a sara siriri na a Allemeand na nuu 1940 na a la sara kua na a wamüngö-ndo au lieu ti tene a ta tiri na ala

en: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".
sg: Na lango ti 15 nze ti kukuru ngu 1940, A Alliés a mû France ti mbongo , iri ti läkätängö ni ayeke "Opération Dragoon".

en: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.
sg: Na yenga ûse, a Americains na a turugu ti france so yeke senge a zi france ti banga na ala a turunêe na ndo ti a Allemagne

en: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
sg: Civilisation ayeke mbeni hïngängö-ndo oko so mbeni bûngbi tî âzo kangbi ni na popo ti ala na a duti na ndo oko na a sara nga kua.

en: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
sg: Mbupa so iri ayeke civilisation a londo na ya ti latin civilis, so a tënë civil, so a bungbi na latin civis, so a ye ti tene waködörö, na civitas, so a tënë gbata na ti fa nda ni na mayëre wara na mbeni yöngö ti bûngbi tî âzo.

en: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
sg: A cités-États ayeke a tâkâ ti a ködörö. hingängö ndo a hunda töngö ti hinga ngo ye na a gba ti a bondeko wagamë, mbeni pagerê ti hingangö-mbeti ti mbîrîmbîrî.

en: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
sg: A kêtê hingango ye ayeke girisa lakue na ala za kambisä ti sêndâdünîa pëpe na nga a lingbi ti inga ala tongana civilisation pëpe.

en: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.
sg: Na tango ti bira ti lipandäa, A ködörö bale oko na ota a lekere wokongo bê govoroma, hâkalö ayeke fade composante oko so ayeke na ngangu ti a surä ti Confédération ni.

en: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.
sg: Hakalo ayeke fade na ngangu pëpe ti za na ngangu kiri na , nga so fade si exécutif ayeke da pëpe wara ngbanga na ya ti ködörö ni, lo lingbi ti za na a wa ngangü ti letäa so fade ayeke coopérative pëpe, ti tene fade a sara si a zo a kpe a ndia.

en: It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states.
sg: Lo yeke nga fade na ngangu ti hon ndo ti a ndia fiscale na a ngere na ya ti letäa.

en: The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
sg: A surä a hunda fade yengo-da ti a zo kue ti a letäa kozo ni si ala lingbi ti ye da na a letäa a mû a bê govorama na mbumbuse ni si a sêlê ni ayeke ka da pëpe.

en: Italy's national football, along with German national football team is the second most successful team in the world and were the FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.
sg: Ndembo ti gerê ti ködörö ti Italie, na bungbi ti ndembo ti gerê ti ködörö ti Allemagne ayeke ûse a bungbi so ayeke na kangu mingi na ya ti dunia na lo yeke wa songo benda ti ndemo ti gerê na ngu 2006.

en: Popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water-polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey and F1 motor racing.
sg: A nguru so iri a wu mingi a yeke ndembo ti gerê, na ndembo ti maboko, ndembö ti gbanda, water polo, escrime, rugby, cyclisme, hockey ti glace, hockey ti roulette na mandako ti a auto F1.

en: Winter sports are most popular in the Northern regions, with Italians competing in international games and Olympic events.
sg: Nguru ti hiver ayeke nguru so a wu mingi na ya ti gbeködörö ti banga, na a zo ti ködörö sêse ti italie a gue mingi na a ngui ti olympiques.

en: Japans holds nearly 7,000 islands (the biggest being Honshu), making Japan the 7th largest island in the world!
sg: Japan ayeke na a ndo-mbutu 7000 (Kota ni kue ayeke Honshu) so a sara si Japan a ga 7e kota ndo-mbutu ti dunia.

en: Due to the cluster/group of islands Japan has, Japan is often referred to, on a geographical stance, as an "archipelago"
sg: Tene ti a bungbi ti a ndo-bumto so Japon ayeke na ni, A soro fade Japan tongana ndo ti bango ndo ti sêndâsêse so a iri ni "archipel"

en: Taiwan beginning start way back in 15th century where European sailors passing by record the island’s name as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island.
sg: Na tongo nda ni Taiwan a londo na ngu ngbangbo 15e , so si a marine ti poto na hon ngo ti ala mû iri ti ndu-mbutu ni tongana d'Ilha Formosa, wara pendere ndo-mbutu.

en: In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations.
sg: Na ngu 1624, didä ti a néerlandais ti indes ti to a sara mbeni base na ya ti Taiwan ti mbongo-do, so a mû lêgë ti sarango céréales ti a waködörö na a mûngo a chinois na kua ti tene ala sara kua na ya ti yaka ti lôso na ti sukâli.

en: In 1683, Qing dynasty (1644-1912) forces take control of Taiwan’s western and northern coastal areas and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885.
sg: Na ngu 1683, a ngangu ti dynastie ti Qing(1644-1912) a mû a ndo ti ndo-bumtu ti Taïwan na ala tënë Taïwan a ga kêtê ködörö ti gbâködörö-va ti Qing na ngu 1885.

en: In 1895, after defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it cedes sovereignty over Taiwan to Japan, which rules the island until 1945.
sg: Na ngu 1895, na peko ti tingo ni na ya ti kozo bira so a tingbi chinois na a Japonais (1894-1895), govoroma ti Qing a su traité ti Shimonoseki, so na ya ni lo yeda ti za gbia ti lo na ndo ti Taïwan na Japon, so a le gbia fade ti si na ngu 1945.

en: Machu Picchu consist of three main structures, namely Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.
sg: Machu Picchu ayeke na sêyâgbê ota, so ti wara Intihuatana, da ti nzapa ti la na kubû ni ayeke na nyöpulâ ota.

en: Most of the buildings on the edges of the complex have been rebuilt in order to give tourists a better idea of how they originally appeared.
sg: Mingi ti a da so ayeke na yanga ti zâkâri so a lekere ti tene a mû na a gene zoni bango ndo na ndo ti ndâ ni.

en: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and restoration continues till today.
sg: Na ngu 1976, lani ka a lekere bale ota pourcent ti Machu Picchu na nga lekerengo ni a ngba ti laso.

en: For example, the most common still image photography format in the world is 35mm, which was the dominant film size at the close of the analog film era.
sg: Nga na tâpande , fûnda ti limo so a luti na ya ti dunia ayeke 35mm, so ayeke saterê ti limo so a mû ndo ti nda ngoi ti limo analogique.

en: It is still produced today, but more importantly its aspect ratio has been inherited by digital camera image sensor formats.
sg: A ngba ti sara lo lakue, a hon kue saterê ti limo ni a wara mäda na a fûnda ti capteur ti gbakuru ti limo numerique.

en: The 35mm format is actually, somewhat confusingly, 36mm in width by 24mm in height.
sg: A sara fûnda so ayeke mm 35, a lingbi ti kärängö zo, na mm 36 ti kêtê yongo na ndo ti mm 24 ti yongo na nduzu.

en: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2.
sg: Songo na popo ti yongo na nduzu na kêtê yongo ti fûnda (a kangbi ya ni a bale oko na ûse ti te ne a wara songo so ayeke polele) a iri ni a tene 3:2.

en: Many common formats (APS family of formats, for example) are equal to or closely approximate this aspect ratio.
sg: Kue a lingbi terê wara ayeke nduru na fûnda songo ti yongo na nduzu na kêtê yongo.

en: The much-abused and often-ridiculed rule of thirds is a simple guideline creating dynamism while keeping a measure of order in an image.
sg: Ndia ti a ota a fün sen so nga a lakue a mumana ayeke mbeni kamba ti fango lêgë so a sara sêngangü na a bata hakango ti lêgë ni na ya ti limo.

en: It states that the most effective place for the main subject is at the intersection of lines dividing the image into thirds vertically and horizontally (see example).
sg: Lo fa nga ndo so ayeke ngangu na ndo ti a tö yêkpälë ayeke tingbi ngo terê ti a kamba so a kangbi ya ti ota verticalement na nga horizontalement.

en: During this period of European history, the Catholic Church, which had become rich and powerful, came under scrutiny.
sg: Na ngoi ti tângo ti lissoro ti a wapoto, da ti nzapa catholique a ga wamosoro, ngangu na a ga mbeni ye ti gbëngbë wësëngö.

en: For over a thousand years the Christian religion had bound European states together despite differences in language and customs. I
sg: A ndo ngu saki na ndo ni, a wamabe ti nzapa a yeke kânga a zo ti ködörö ti pötö na popo ti ala kamême a yanga ti kodro so kângbi popo ti ala na a sara ngo ye.

en: Its all-pervading power affected everyone from king to commoner.
sg: Ngangou ti lo a yeke na ndo kue na a mu a zo kue, a londo na gbia ti si na mbumbuse-zo.

en: One of the main Christian tenets is that wealth should be used to alleviate suffering and poverty and that the monetary funds of the church are there specifically for that reason.
sg: Oko ti na ndia ti a wamäbê a yeke so, mosoro a lingbi ti mu lege ti yâpu passi na a lingbi si nginza kue ti da ti nzapa a mu tene ni.

en: The central authority of the church had been in Rome for over a thousand years and this concentration of power and money led many to question whether this tenet was being met.
sg: Walëngö gbia ti da nzapa a yeke na Rome dipïi ngu ngbangbo oko na bumbi ngo ti ngangü na nguinza a mu lege na gba ti a zo ti hunda wara a kpë ndia ni.

en: Soon after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain initiated a naval blockade of Germany.
sg: Kêtê na peko ti tongo nda ti a sêlëngö-ngangü, Grande-Bretagne a bi mbeni kanga ngo lêgë na ndo ti mangbôkô ti Allemagne.

en: The strategy proved effective, cutting off vital military and civilian supplies, although this blockade violated generally accepted international law codified by several international agreements of the past two centuries.
sg: Kodë-birä ni ayeke fade ngangu, kanga lêgë na müngö-mabôko na a turugu na a mîfi ti a zo, kamême, si kanga ngo lêgë so a kpë pëpe sêndâ ndïä international ti a tanga ti ngu ngbangbo ûse.

en: Britain mined international waters to prevent any ships from entering entire sections of ocean, causing danger to even neutral ships.
sg: Grande-Bretagne a mû fade a le ti ngu internantionale kue ti tene lo kanga lêgë na a mangbôkô ti tene a linga ya ti a ocean kota ngu-hingo, na a bi kota kpale na ndo ti a mangbôkô so ayeke na ya ni pëpe.

en: Since there was limited response to this tactic, Germany expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare.
sg: Tene ti so kiri ngo na peko ti tactique ayeke kêtê, Allemagne ayeke ku fade mbeni kiri ngo na peko ni to a kpa tongana bira ti gbeti ngo so kpengo ndia ayeke da pëpe.

en: During the 1920s, the prevailing attitudes of most citizens and nations was that of pacifism and isolation.
sg: Na ya ti ngu 1920, särängö-yê ti ngangu ti a mingi ti a waködörö na a ködörö ayeke lo ti pacifisme na ti dütïngö-oko.

en: After seeing the horrors and atrocities of war during World War I, nations desired to avoid such a situation again in the future.
sg: Na peko ti a sioni ye ti bira so ayeke na ya ti kozo bira ti dunia, a ködörö a hunda ti kpe mara ti a ye so ya ti sêngbändä.

en: In 1884, Tesla moved to the United States of America to accept a job with the Edison Company in New York City.
sg: Na ngu 1884, Tesla a gue na États-Unis d'Amérique ti yeda na mbeni kua na ya société so iri ni ayeke Edison na New York.

en: He arrived in the US with 4 cents to his name, a book of poetry, and a letter of recommendation from Charles Batchelor (his manager in his previous job) to Thomas Edison.
sg: Lo si fade na États-Unis na pata 4 cents na iri ti lo, mbeni buku ti pagao na gerêmbëtï ti wängö ti Charles Batchelo (ti ngbêne kotazo ti lo) na Thomas Edison.

en: Ancient China had a unique way of showing different time periods; each stage of China or each family that was in power was a distinctive dynasty.
sg: Ngbêne Chine ayeke na mayëre oko ti fango a ngoi so ayeke ndê; na lütïngö ti chine wara a sewa oko na oko so ayeke fade na ngunu ayeke dynastie ndêndê

en: Also between each dynasty was an unstable age of divided provinces. The best-known of these periods was the Three Kingdoms epoch taking place for 60 years between the Han and the Jin Dynasty.
sg: Na nga na popo ti a dynastie oko na oko ayeke fade a mbeni ngu ti tïängö-kpô ti a kêtê ködörö so a kangbi. Lo so iri ni a wu fade na ngoi ti lani ayeke a gbâködörö-va ota so a gue na ya ti ngu 60 na popo ti a dynastie ti Han na ti Jin.

en: During these periods fierce warfare took place between many nobles fighting for the throne.
sg: Na a ya ti a ngoi ni so, ngangu bira ayeke fade na popo ti a wa mossoro so ayeke tiri tene ti ngendegbia.

en: The Three Kingdoms was one of the bloodiest eras in Ancient China’s history thousands of people died fighting to sit in the highest seat in the grand palace at Xi’an.
sg: A ködörö-gbïä ota ayeke fade ala so tuku mênë mingi na ya ti ngbêne mbai ti chine. A zo saki ngbangbo na ndo ni a wara kua na ya ti bira ni tene ti ngo gingo lêgë ti dutingo na ndo ti mbata so ayeke na nduzu ti ti kota yongu na Xi’an.

en: There are a lot of social and political effects such as the use of metric system, a shift from absolutism to republicanism, nationalism and the belief the country belongs to the people not to one sole ruler.
sg: Gbati pendâ sociaux na a poroso tongana sarango système métrique, na hon ngo ti absolutisme au républicanisme, ti yengo-ködörö, na ti mango na be so ködörö ayeke tene ti a waködörö na ayeke fade pëpe tene ti zo so ayeke na ndo ti mbata.

en: Also after the Revolution occupations were open to all male applicants allowing the most ambitious and successful to succeed.
sg: Na nga na peko ti lësüä, a zi fade a kua tene ti a wamandako ti koli so ayeke na yango-iri na ala so a sö benda

en: Same goes for the military because instead of army rankings being based on class they were now based on cailaber.
sg: Ayeke nga fade tene ti a tutugu ngbanga ti soro a turugu ayeke na na ndo mbu, ala yeke fade so na ndo ti cailaber.

en: The French Revolution also inspired many other repressed working class people of other country's to began their own revolutions.
sg: lësüä ti waködörö ti France a mû ngangu na a gbati a wakua so a bâa passi mingi na ya ti a mbeni ködörö, na ala tondani ti sara lësüä ti ala.

en: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation.
sg: Muhammad a sara nzara ti inga a ye na ndo ti a tene ti gigi ti dunia, lo gue fade na ya ti a du tene so iri ayeke 'Hira" na ndo ti a hötö ti "Noor" (zigä) ti tene lo bâa ni.

en: he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations.
sg: Dutene ni so fade a ngba na fini na ya ti ngoi, a mu mbeni limo so ayeke na fini dans ndo ti a bibê ti Mahummad.

en: Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world.
sg: Dutingo kpo na li ti oko ahoto ti banga ti Mecque, dutene ni ayeke yambe na tanga ti azo ni.

en: In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. Once inside the cave, it is a total isolation.
sg: Na fade, ayeke ngangu pëpe ti wara ni kamême si i inga so lo yeke da. La oko na ya ti dutene ni, ayeke ndê.

en: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
sg: Mbeni ye ti bango ni ayeke nda pëpe, gi nduzu , na pendere na ndo ti a hoto so ayeke ka. A lingbi nga ti ma wara ti bâa mo na ya ti dutene ni so pëpe.

en: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only one of the seven wonders that is still standing today.
sg: Kota Pyramide ti Gizeh ayeke oko ti a mbârâmbârâ ti nzöyê so ayeke na nduzu laso.

en: Built by the Egyptians in the third century BCE, the Great Pyramid is one of many large pyramid structures built to honor dead Pharaoh.
sg: A Égyptiens lekere fade lo na ngu ngbangbo ota kozo ti ngoi so i yeke da, kota Pyramide ayeke oko ti a gbati a kota structures pyramidale so a lekere ti mû nengo na kua ti Pharaon.

en: The Giza Plateau, or "Giza Necropolis" in the Egyptian Valley of the Dead contains several pyramids (of which the great pyramid is the largest), several small tombs, several temples, and the great Sphinx.
sg: Lendo ti Giza wara Necropolis of Giza na ya ti a pöpö-hötö ti égypt ti a kua ayeke na gbati a pyramide ( Na nga kota ni pyramide ayeke lo so ya ti lo a zara), gbati a duti kua, gbati a danzapa na nga kota Sphinx.

en: The great pyramid was created to honor the Pharaoh Khufu, and many of the smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were built to honor Khufu's wives and family members.
sg: A lekere Kota pyramide a ti mû ngo nengo na pharaon Khéops, na a sara nga gbati a pyramide, a duti kua, a da-nzapa so ayeke kêtê ti mû nengo na a wali na a sewa ti Khéops.

en: The "up bow" mark looks like a V and the "down bow mark" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side.
sg: Pëli ti "gindî so a gue na nduzu" a kpa V na nga "pëli ti gindî so a gue na gbeni" a eke a mbeni garâfu wara carré so si mbage ti terê ni ayeke da pëpe.

en: Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow.
sg: So a gue na nduzu a ye ti tene ala lingbi ti tonda ni a pônde ni na ala pusu gindî ni, na gbeni a ye ti tene ala lingi tonda ni na ndo ti nzêgê (ndo so maboko ti ala a gbu gindî ni) na ala gboto gindî ni.

en: An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive.
sg: Gindi na mbagë ti nduzu a sara mbeni lego so a de, na si gindi na mbagë ti gbeni ayeke ngangu mingi.

en: Feel free to pencil in your own marks, but remember the printed bowing marks are there for a musical reason, so they should usually be respected.
sg: Na ala lingbi ti za pëli ti ala na këmbëtï, na nga ala dabe ti ala na pëli ti archet si a ayeke da tene ti a ye ti mozoko, na a lingi ala a kpe dia so.

en: The terrified King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette their two young children (11 year old Marie Therese and four year old Louis-Charles) and the King's sister, Madam Elizabeth, on the 6th October 1789 were forced back to Paris from Versailles by a mob of market women.
sg: Gbia Louis XVI a ti na mbeto, wogbia Marie Marie-Antoinette na a kette a melenge ti ala (Marie Thérèse ngu 11 na Louis-Charles ngu osio) na ita ti gbia ti wali Elizabeth, na lango ti ngberere 6 ngu 1789 a kiri fade na Paris de Versailles na lêgë ti a wali so a tambula.

en: In a carriage, they traveled back to Paris surrounded by a mob of people screaming and shouting threats against the King and Queen.
sg: Na ndo ti a mbarata ala linda fade Paris na a zo a nguru ala na a dekongo na bëngölê na terê ti Gbia na Wogbia.

en: The mob of people forced the King And Queen to have their carriage windows wide open.
sg: A zo ni a sara si Gbia na wogbia a zi nyöpulâ ti kutukutu ti ala.

en: At one point a member of the mob waved the head of a royal guard killed at Versailles in front of the terrified Queen.
sg: Na mbenu ngoi, mbeni zo na ya ti bungbi ti a zo ni a hingi li ti mbeni turugu so a fa lo na le ti wogbia so mbeto a gbu lo.

en: The war expenditures of U.S. imperialism in the conquest of the Philippines were paid for by the Filipino people themselves.
sg: A kängö-nginza ti bira ti impérialisme américain na ya ti mûngo Philippine a ga yongo so a a waködörö ti philippine la a futa ni.

en: They were compelled to pay taxes to the U.S. colonial regime to defray a major part of the expenditures and the interest on bonds floated in the name of the Philippine government through the Wall Street banking houses.
sg: A gbu fade a la ti tene a futa kiri na ködörö-va ti Ameriqueti tene a kanga mbage ti kängö-nginza na a matabïsi na ndo ti përëngö-ndo na iri ti govoroma ti Philippine na intermediare ti a bânge ti Wall Street.

en: Of course, the superprofits derived from the protracted exploitation of the Filipino people would constitute the basic gains of U.S. imperialism.
sg: Ta tene , a kota matabisi so a sigi na ya ti le ngo gbia a ndo ti a waködörö ti philippine ayeke fade fûta ti imperialism Americain.

en: To understand the Templars one must understand the context that prompted the creation of the order.
sg: Ti hinga a wa-nzapa, fade zo a lingbi ti hinga contexte so a pusu a la ti lekere molongo

en: The age where the events took place is commonly referred as the High Middle Ages the period of European history in the 11th, 12th, and 13th centuries (AD 1000–1300).
sg: Ngu na a matanga so a si fade , a iri ni Haut Moyen Âge, ngoi ti mbai ti poto a na ti ngu ngbangbo 11e, 12e nga na 13e (1000-1300 na peko ti JC).

en: The High Middle Ages were preceded by the Early Middle Ages and followed by the Late Middle Ages, which by convention ends around 1500.
sg: Haut Moyen Âge ayeke na peko ti Haut Moyen Âge na peko ti li i yeke wara Bas Moyen Âg, so a hunzi na lêgë ti mângbi na ngu 1500.

en: Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology.
sg: Déterminisme ti a fini kodëkua a yeke ye so a bumbi gba ti a bibê na ya ti sara ngo ye, so a londo na fini kodëkua wara përëngö-ndo fini kodëkua, wara na sêyêtara âdu tî so päsä ti a zo a yeke fa lêgë na ye ti boroli ti gbeni so a bumbi na a ndïä ti gïngösêndâyê na a fumbä ti ala na ya ti fini kodëkua.

en: Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has "effects" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned.
sg: Mingui ti a fa ngo tènè na ti déterminisme ti kodëkua a kangbi böndöngö bibê ûse : ti tènè mäïngö na fini kodëkua, lo mû pekô ti kötä legue na ndo ti a lëngö-ngangü ti hïngängö-mbëtï wara porosö na fini kodëkua na türünëngö ti pendâ na ndo ti a sociétés ti so mëngö ti tènè socialement.

en: For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads.
sg: Tènè ti tâpande, ë lingbi ti tènè biani kutukutu a mu legue na lekere ngo legue.

en: However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership.
sg: Kamëme, mbeni gbânda ti legue ti ködörö a yeke könömï pepe ngbanga ti so wüngö ti a kutukutu a ke mingui ape, fini sêkodëkua ti lëngö a yeke mâi na tènè ti dîri na ngêrë ti wara ngo kutukutu.

en: Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies.
sg: Douti ngo wa ti a kutukuku a gbôto nga mbeni pândä so a ga na ndaû na ndo ti legue, so a sara lëkërëngö-yê fini kodëkua tene ti sênî ti lekerengo a terê so a buba.

en: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.
sg: Romantisme ayeke kota lê yê ti déterminisme ti hinga ngo ndo, so a gboto a kota wasungo mbeti tongana Goethe, Fichte na Schlegel.

en: In the context of Romanticism, the geography molded individuals, and over time customs and culture related to that geography arose, and these, being in harmony with the place of the society, were better than arbitrarily imposed laws.
sg: Na ya ti contexte ti romantisme, sêndâsêse a sara a zo na ya ti ngoi , a ngobo na a hingango ndo a bungbi na sêndâsêse a bâa sigi na ala ni so ayeke na yëngbïngö na duti ti ya ti a bungbi ayeke nzoni ndia so a za fade tene ti ket ngoi.

en: In the manner that Paris is known as the fashion capital of the contemporary world, Constantinople was regarded as the fashion capital of feudal Europe.
sg: Na lege ti mayëre so Paris a hînga tongana kötä-gbätä ti lamode ti gîgî contemporain, a bâa Constantinople mbênî bîrï tongana kötä-gbätä ti lamode ti Pötö féodale.

en: Its renown for being an epicenter of luxury began in about 400 A.D. and lasted up until about 1100 A.D.
sg: Kpëngbängö ti lo ti tene lo ga bê ti a ye ti mosoro a tonda ni na ngu 400 na peko ti JC na a gue ti si na ngu 1100 na peko ti JC.

en: Its status declined during the twelfth century mainly due to the fact that Crusaders had returned bearing gifts such as silks and spices that were valued more than what Byzantine markets offered.
sg: Sitatïi ti lo a fa na ngoi ti ngûngbangbo 12, ngbônga na tene ti so sângbi ni a kiri a ga a matabïsi tongana kâmba-tetere nga na a ëpîsi so a yeke na nguere ngangu so gara ti a byzantins a yeke mu.

en: It was at this time that the transfer of the title of Fashion Capital from Constantinople to Paris was made.
sg: A yeke na tango so si güëngö na litënë ti kötä-gbätä ti lamôde de Constantinople na Paris.

en: Gothic style peaked in the period between the 10th - 11th centuries and the 14th century.
sg: Style gothique a wara apogée ti lo na popo ti ngu ngbangbo 10 na 11 na 14.

en: At the beginning dress was heavily influenced by the Byzantine culture in the east.
sg: A tongonda ni, a bongo ayeke fade mingi lë ngangü na sêndâgao ti byzantine ti tö

en: However, due to the slow communication channels, styles in the west could lag behind by 25 to 30 year.
sg: Kamême, tene ti gue ngo yeke ti a canal ti tîsângbi, a style ti a wapoto a lingbi ti duti na peko tene ti ngu 25 na ngu 30.

en: towards the end of the Middle Ages western Europe began to develop their own style. one of the biggest developments of the time as a result of the crusades people began to use buttons to fasten clothing.
sg: Nduru na hunzingo ti Moyen Âge, Poto a tondani ti sara style ti lo veni, oko ti a kota mäïngö ti ngoi ni ka ayeke peko ti croisade, a zo a tonda ni ti mû bouton ti gbu na bongo ti ala.

en: Subsistence agriculture is agriculture carried out for the production of enough food to meet just the needs of the agriculturalist and his/her family.
sg: Dengo yaka ti subsistance ayeke yaka so a sara lo ti lë mingi ti tene wafango yaka na a sewa ti lo a wara kobe ti ala.

en: Subsistence agriculture is a simple, often organic, system using saved seed native to the ecoregion combined with crop rotation or other relatively simple techniques to maximize yield.
sg: Dengo yaka ti subsistance ayeke systeme so ayeke senge, lakue biologique, so a mû a le ti a kasa so a a bata ni na lêgë ti écorégion so a bungbi na bïrïngïngö ti a ye ti yaka wara na a mbeni kode kua so ayeke senge ti sara si a kobe ni a sigi mingi.

en: Historically most farmers were engaged in subsistence agriculture and this is still the case in many developing nations.
sg: Na lêgë tî mbai mingi ti a wayakaa mû terê ti ala na ya ti yaka ti subsistance na ayeke lakue yeso ayeke na ya ti a ködörö so ayeke na mäïngö

en: Subcultures bring together like-minded individuals who feel neglected by societal standards and allow them to develop a sense of identity.
sg: A sous-culture ayeke a zo so a kangbi a mara gbungo li so a bâa tongana a zo a sara kirikiri ala na lêgë ti a sêndïä ti bungbi na a sara si a a mai a bibê so ayeke oko.

en: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.
sg: A sous-culture a lingbi ti duti ndê na lêgë ti ngu, na ti ngunda a mara, ti mbu, nga na ti sêyêterê ti a wabûngbi.

en: The qualities that determine a subculture as distinct may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, sexual, geographical, or a combination of factors.
sg: A kalitëe so a sara a sous-culture ayeke ndê , a lingbi nga ti duti linguistique, esthétique, ti a ye ti nzapa, ti poroso, ti dutingo koli na wali, ti géographique wara ti bungbi ngo ti a nenêe-tënë.

en: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashions, mannerisms, and argot.
sg: A wabûngbi ti sous-cultures a fa dutingo ti ala lakue na lege ti sarango ye ndê na mbeni zoroko ti style so ayeke na lamôde, na mayëre na nga na argot.

en: One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up.
sg: Oko ti a methode so a sara na ye mingi ti fa ngangu ti socialisation ayeke ti tene a luti na ndo ti a mbeni ti a melenge so ayeke wamawa, na lêgë ti sarango ye kirirkiri so si a wara lêgë ti tene a kotazo a socialisé na ala na tango so ala ngba melenge.

en: Such children are called "feral" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment.
sg: A iri a melenge so a basënzi. A honde fade a mbeni a melenge basënzi (a sewa ti la veni); na ya ti a mingi ti a kpale ni a melenge so a za ala wara a sewa ti ala a bi ala ngbanga ti so ala yeke na mbeni kpale ti hingango ndo wara ti saterê.

en: Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away.
sg: A melenge basënzi a wara nga fade a ngangu a sëngö wara a ngangu-ye kozo ni si a bi ala wara ala kpe.

en: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.
sg: A mbene ayeke a nyama la a bata ala, a mbeni a lango ala ako na ya ti gigi.

en: When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans.
sg: Tongana a fade ayeke a nyama la a bata ala melenge so a fa sarango ye tongana a nyama tongana mbeto na mbage ti a zo.

en: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond.
sg: Kamême, si mandango ye na lêgë ti a pialö a lingbi ti sara fade mandango ye a woko na nzoni, döngö ni a gue a yo na ndo ni.

en: Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project.
sg: Döngö ayeke mbeni méthode ti mandango ye pëpe mais ayeke mû ngo maboko na a zo so a ngba ti manda fini ye, tongana sarango ye na programme informatique wara fini pialö.

en: Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office.
sg: Döngö a lingbi nga ti duti virtuel wara ta ye, so ti tene wafango mbeti ayeke mbeni saterê ti döngö tongana trombone na ya ti Microsoft Office.

en: Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
sg: Döngö virtuel a yeke na ya ti logiciel na ayeke tene ti hunda ngo ndo hîo na a fa ndâ ti a procédure so a lingbi ti gbu hon ti a wamadan ngo mbeti.

en: Children are placed in Foster Care for a wide variety of reasons that range from neglect, to abuse, and even to extortion.
sg: Nda ti zango a melenge na ya ti sewa ti yämbängö-ndo ayeke ndê ndê, a londo na sara ngo ye ti kirikiri ti si na nga gbüngö na ngangü.

en: No child should ever have to grow up in an environment that is not nurturing, caring, and educational, but they do.
sg: Melenge oko a lingbi ti konon na ya ti ndo so ayeke nzoni tene ti batango lo pëpe, na nga mandango mbeti na fade ala konon na yani.

en: We perceive the Foster Care System to be a safety zone for these children.
sg: I bâa Système ti Zango a Molenge na ya ti sewa tongana nzoni ndo ti siriri ti a melenge so.

en: Our foster care system is supposed to provide safe homes, loving caregivers, stable education, and reliable health care.
sg: Système ti zango na ya ti sewa so a yamba zo a lingbi ti mû nzoni sewa, nzoni saterê, zoni matango ye so a gbu sêse, na a käïngö-kobêla so ayeke nzoni.

en: Foster care is supposed to provide all the necessities that were lacking in the home they were previously taken from.
sg: Système ti zango na ya ti sewa a lingbi ti mû a yeso a hônga so ayeke fade na ya ti da so a zi ala da so pëpe.

en: The Internet combines elements of both mass and interpersonal communication.
sg: Gbanda tere a bumbi a lê yê ti tîsângbi ti a gba ti a zo na popo ti a zo nga.

en: The distinct characteristics of the Internet lead to additional dimensions in terms of the uses and gratifications approach.
sg: A nzerë ti gbanda tere a sara mbeni könöngö-lê na ndâ ti dölïngö ti sara ngo ye na ti a séngé séngé.

en: For example, “learning” and “socialization” are suggested as important motivations for Internet use (James et al., 1995).
sg: Ta pande ti mändängö-kua na ti socialisation a fa piapa tongana a ngangu zïängö-nzara ti sara ngo gbanda tere (James et al., 1995).

en: “Personal involvement” and “continuing relationships” were also identified as new motivation aspects by Eighmey and McCord (1998) when they investigated audience reactions to websites.
sg: Müngö-yângâ ti zo mvenîna na a kambisa ti lakue nga a mû töngana a fini ngôbo so a zïängö-nzara ti Eighmey et McCord (1998) na tango so lo ngba ti manda mbeti na ndo ti a särängö-yêti a sites web ti zo kue.

en: The use of video recording has led to important discoveries in the interpretation of micro-expressions, facial movements which last a few milliseconds.
sg: Sarango limo a mû lêgë ti fango ngangu a fangonda ti ye ti a kêtê tene ngo tene, na a yëngïngö ti lê so a sara millisecondes.

en: In particular, it is claimed that one can detect whether a person is lying by interpreting micro-expressions correctly.
sg: Na veni, i tara ti fa si tongana zo a tene veni na fango nda ti a nzoni kêtê tene.

en: Oliver Sacks, in his paper The President's Speech, indicated how people who are unable to understand speech because of brain damage are nevertheless able to assess sincerity accurately.
sg: Oliver Sacks na ya ti buku ti lo "The President's Speech, a fa tongana nye a zo ayeke lingbi ti maa ya ti tene ngbanga ti a lésions cérébrales a lingbi ti haka ta tene na lêgë ni.

en: He even suggests that such abilities in interpreting human behavior may be shared by animals such as domestic dogs.
sg: Lo fa piapa so si a ngangu ti fango nda ti ye ti a sarango ye ti a zo a lingbi nga fade ti tene a nyama a kangbi ni, a nyama tongana mbo.

en: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed.
sg: A gingo ye ti ngu ngbangbo bale ûse a fa so, a lingbi ti wara pools ûse ti gbian ngo ye: lo so a honde na lo so a tene.

en: Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation.
sg: sänzëmä a za fini gbian ngo ti génétique na sorongo ye na zi ye na ya ti pool ti gbian ngo ye so a tene.

en: Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
sg: Kangbi ngo ye na bungbi ngo ye a zakaa gue na gana popo ti a pool ûse na a wagamë ndê.

en: Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources.
sg: Na ya ti bênyämä, ayeke ngangu na primate so ayeke na ti systeme digestif tongana ti zo ti nzere na nzara ti lo na acides aminé na lêgë ti a kûngbâ ti bangë.

en: Moreover, failure to do so has serious consequences: growth depression, malnutrition, and ultimately death.
sg: Na ndo ni, ti tene a sara a ngangu ye ti sioni: gue ngo yeke ti konon ngo, tengo kobe zoni pëpe na nga na peko ni kua.

en: The most readily accessible plant resources would have been the proteins accessible in leaves and legumes, but these are hard for primates like us to digest unless they are cooked.
sg: a kungba ti bangë so a lingbi ti wara senge ayeke fade a protéine so a ayeke na ya ti a kugbe nga ayeke ngangu na a primate ti neka terê tongana i , so a lingbi fade ti to kozo si.

en: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.
sg: Na mbagë a kobe so a londo na ya ti a nyama (diyän, kangi nga na a para) ayeke fade ngangu pëpe ti neka terê, na nga ala mû gbati a protéine na kota sêkönöngö so ayeke na acides aminé so a lingbi.

en: All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their "protein problem" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today.
sg: Tongana i bâa ye kue, i lingbi ti duti na mosümä pëpe ngbanga ti so a kotara ti i a lekere lani kpale ti protéines ti ala nga tongana lêgë oko na a seko ayeke sara na a ti bênyämä.

en: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes).
sg: Fango ya ti lango ayeke ye so ala zingo mo veni na ya ti lango so a yele na lêgë ni, na ala yeke langa na peko ti zene pënzëngbonga (10 ti si na 60)

en: This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you.
sg: Na fade a lingbi nga ti zingo ala yeke ti tene a kiri ala na hinga ngo ndo sans ti tene a zingo ala kue.

en: If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off.
sg: Na si ti tene ala za sâa ti ala tene ti lango, ala lingbi ti za lo na ya ti na terê ti ala na ya ti buku ti ala, na fade ayeke mû lêgë na ala ti mingo lo.

en: Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.
sg: A mbeni söröngö ye a wara nda ti ala na lêgë ti biorythme so ayeke fade na lêgë ti yongo gbati ngu (tongana mgu wara dutëe) kozo ni ti lango, so ayeke mû lêgë ti tene zo a zingo ti sara hînön.

en: The amount of inner peace a person possesses correlates oppositely to the amount of tension in one’s body and spirit.
sg: Kungba ti siriri so zo ayeke na ni, ayeke na bungbi ngo ndê na kungba ti tasïön so ayeke nga na ya ti terê lo nga na yingo ti lo.

en: The lower the tension, the more positive the life force present. Every person has the potential to find absolute peace and contentment.
sg: Tongana tasïön ayeke na gbeni, mingi ayeke ngangu ti fini ayeke nzoni. Zo oko oko ayeke na ngangu ti wara siriri na ngia ti biaku.

en: Everyone can achieve enlightenment. The only thing standing in the way of this goal is our own tension and negativity.
sg: Zo kue a lingbi ti si a wärängö-yingö. ye so oko ayeke kpale ayeke tasïön ti sioni so i yeke na ni.

en: The Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of Buddha, but were extended by the mahayana path of love and by a lot of techniques from Indian Yoga.
sg: Bouddhisme ti tibétain ayeke na ndo ti a fango ye ti Bouddha, nga fade a gboto ya ni na lêgë ti mahayana ti yengo terê na a gbati a pialo ti yoga indien.

en: In principle the Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It consists of Kundalini Yoga, meditation and the path of all-embracing love.
sg: Fade, bouddhisme tibétain ayeke ngangu pëpe. Na ya ti lo mo yeke wara Kundalini Yoga, gbungo li na lêgë ti yengo terê ti dunia.

en: With Kundalini Yoga the Kundalini energy (enlightenment energy) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras and visualizations.
sg: Na Kundalini Yoga, ngangu ti Kundalini (ngangu ti wärängö-yingö) ayeke sigi na lêgë ti a duti ti yoga, a manda ngo ye ti wungo a mantra na a bango ndo.

en: The center of Tibetan meditation is the Deity Yoga. Through the visualization of various deities the energy channels are cleaned, the chakras are activated and the enlightenment consciousness is created.
sg: Bê ti gbungo li tibétaine ayeke yoga ti Déité. Na legue ti a nzapa ndê ndê, a lêgë ti ngangu so a sukûla, a chakra ayeke a kua na a hingango ndo ti zingo a lekere.

en: Germany was a common enemy in World War 2, leading to cooperation between the USSR and USA. With the end of the war the clashes of system, process and culture led to the countries falling out.
sg: Allemagne ayeke fade oko ennemi so na tango ti ûse bira ti dunia 2 a pusu URSS na États-Unis ti bungbi. Na hunzi ti bira ni, a kpale ti systeme na ti hingango ndo a pusu na kangbi ngo ti a ködörö.

en: With two years of the end of the war, the former allies were now enemies and the Cold War began.
sg: Na ngu ûse ti hunzi ngo ti bira, a ngbene wambere a ga fade a ennemi na Bira ti De a tonda ni.

en: It was to last for the next 40 years and would be fought for real, by proxy armies, on battlefields from Africa to Asia, in Afghanistan, Cuba and many other places.
sg: Lo lingbi ti ninga ngu 40 so ayeke ga na ti tiri bira fade ti taa ni, na a turugu ti procuration, na ndo ti a ndo ti biraa londo na Afrique ti si na Asie, na Afghanistan, na Cuba na nga a mbeni ndo fade.

en: By September 17, 1939, the Polish defense was already broken, and the only hope was to retreat and reorganise along the Romanian bridgehead.
sg: Na lango ti 17 nze ti mvuka 1939, ya ti batango ti pologne a fa na bêkü ni ayeke ti tene ala zi terê ti ala na a lekere terê ti ala na ndo ti li ti gbagbara ti roumanie.

en: However, these plans were rendered obsolete nearly overnight, when over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet's Union Red Army entered and created the Belarussian and Ukrainian fronts after invading the eastern regions of Poland in violation of the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international treaties, both bilateral and multilateral.
sg: So fade a a piakua so a ga fade ngbêne tongana so na ndâadê ni a turugu 800 000 ti lärämä ti ngbengba ti Union soviétique a linda na a lekere hönlê na biélorusse, na Ukraine na peko ti so ala mû Pologne na kengo traité ti siriri ti Riga, , mbeti ti mbere ti non-agression soviéto-polonaise na a tanga ti a mbere internationaux, bilatéraux na nga multilatéraux.

en: Using ships to transport goods is by far the most efficient way to move large amounts of people and goods across oceans.
sg: Mûngo a mangbôkô ti yo na kungba ti ka ngo ni ayeke nzoni lege ti hon ngo na a zo wara na a kungba na ya ti kötä ngû-hîngö.

en: The job of navies has traditionally been to ensure that your country maintains the ability to move your people and goods, while at the same time, interfering with your enemy's ability to move his people and goods.
sg: Kua ti a Marine ayeke ti sara si kodoro ti mo yeke na ngangu ti bata na ti hon na a wakodoro na a kungba ti ala, nga a buba ngo ngangu ti ennemi ti mo na ti tene lo hon na a waködörö ti lo na a kungba ti lo.

en: One of the most noteworthy recent examples of this was the North Atlantic campaign of WWII. The Americans were trying to move men and materials across the Atlantic Ocean to help Britain.
sg: Oko ti a fini tapande ayeke ngangu ayeke kâpä ti Atlantique ti banga na ngoi ti use bira ti dunia. A zo ti ködörö sêse ti Amerîka tara ti hon a zo na a gbakuru na ndo ti nguingo ti mû maboko na Grande-Bretagne.

en: At the same time, the German navy, using mainly U-boats, was trying to stop this traffic.
sg: Na ngoi oko so, aturugu ti ngu ti Zamani, ala gue na mbeni amangboko, ala haka ti kanga lege na tambura ti amangboko na yati ngu.

en: Had the Allies failed, Germany probably would have been able to conquer Britain as it had the rest of Europe.
sg: Tongana a foh mba a ti, Zamani alingbi kete ti mou kodoro ti Grande-Bretanye lege oko tongana a kodoro ti Poto.

en: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.
sg: A ngasa so akpa atene a bata ala kozo ni na nduru na ngu sake bale oko (10 000 ans) na ya hoto ti Zagros na Iran.

en: Ancient cultures and tribes began to keep them for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and skins.
sg: A sara ngo ye ti a kotara ti guiriri a tonda ti bata ala tene ti warango yo ngu ti me, a kua ti li, nyama, nga na poro ti tere.

en: Domestic goats were generally kept in herds that wandered on hills or other grazing areas, often tended by goatherds who were frequently children or adolescents, similar to the more widely known shepherd. These methods of herding are still used today.
sg: Angasa so a bata ni a yeke za na popo ti gbani so a hon na ndo hoto ngana a mbeni ndo ti batango a nyama, ayeke a wa batango ngassa si a yeke bata ala so ayeke a molengue wala a molengue si ngu ti ala a hon kete, na popo ti a wa batango nyama so a hinga ala mingi. alege ti batango nyama tongasso a ngba lakue.

en: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.
sg: A lege ti guengo kutukutu ti wên a na ba gigi na na Angleterre na tongo nda ni ngugbangbo 16.

en: Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day.
sg: Alingbi kwe a wagon ni a sara gui na keke, ala mu lege na a mbarata ti gboto ni na ngangou nga na kota loro nga ti gboto a kota a kungba so ayeke ngangou gui na ndo ti a lege so a yapou si ndao a lingbi ti si nga na ya ti lango oko oko.

en: Crossties were introduced fairly early to hold the tracks in place. Gradually, however, it was realised that tracks would be more efficient if they had a stip of iron on the top.
sg: A fango lege a si yo s ia gbanzi a makongo ndo oko.Kete ne kete,fade so,on lingbi ti hinga a makongo ayeke ngangou mingi tongana ala yeke na pande ti win na ndo ti ala.

en: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.
sg: A ye so a ga tongana a mbeni kode ti lakwe,si win ni a lingbi ti bian a guere ti a wango so ayeke na keke.

en: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.
sg: Ni la,a guere ni ti keke a bian ni na guere ni so ayeke ti win.Na ngou sake oko bale mbassambala na ndo ni bale omana na mbassambala(1767),A kozo a lege ti win a ba gigi.

en: The first known transportation was walking, humans began walking upright two million years ago with the emergence of Homo Erectus (meaning upright man).
sg: Kozo lege ti yo ngo a zo na koutou-koutou a hinga ni gui na lege ti tambela ngo guere,a zo a to nda ti tambela na ndouzou a sala ngou koutou ouse na ma ngo na ndouzou ti Homo Erectus(ti tene zo so a tambela a ndouzou na ndo guere lo).

en: Their predecessors, the Australopithecus did not walk upright as habitually.
sg: Ala so a hon kozo ti ala ayeke,Australopitheque s ala tambela na ndouzou pepe tongana ti lakoue.

en: Bipedal specializations are found in Australopithecus fossils from 4.2-3.9 million years ago, although Sahelanthropus may have walked on two legs as early as seven million years ago.
sg: A oua kode ti guere ouse ayee ouara ala na ya gingo nda ye ti Australopitheques so a hon a ngûndangû 4.2 nga 3.9, atâa Sahelanthropus a lingbi ti tambela na ndo guere ouse a sala ahon ngûndangû mbassambala ahon.

en: We can start living more friendly to the environment, we can join to the environmental movement, and we can even be activists in order to reduce the future suffering in some degree.
sg: I lingbi ti to nda ni ti ba gigi ti nengo a ye so a gourou i,ouala i lingbi nga ti boumbi a sala ngo ye so a ngoro hinga i lingbi ti douti tongana a zo so a lingbi ti kiri na bango passi na peko na lege ti a mbeni senda kode.

en: This is just like symptomatic treatment in many cases. However, if we do not only want a temporary solution, then we should find the root of the problems, and we should deactivate them.
sg: A yeke tongana lekere ngo guere ti a mbeni ye mingi.Tonga so,i ye pepe mbeni oura ngo nda ye oko ti kete ngoi,i lingbi ti ouara gonda ti a kpale so i lingbi zi lege ni.

en: It is obvious enough that the world has changed much because of humankind's scientific and technological advancements, and problems have become greater because of overpopulation and mankind's extravagant lifestyle.
sg: Ayeke lingbi ti tene gigi mobimba a bian ngangou ngbanga ti ma ngo na ndouzou ti a ye ti senda kode ti a zo, si a kpale a ma ngbanga ti ma ngo a ndouzou ti a zo.

en: After its adoption by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft signed by the President of Congress John Hancock and the Secretary Charles Thomson was then sent a few blocks away to the printing shop of John Dunlap.
sg: Na peko ti so a yeda na lo na bongbi ngo ti 4 juillet, mbeni pialo so mokonzi ti bongbi John Hancock a su maboko na gbeni, na wa tondo Charles Thomson a gue da ti tokua na ambeni da ti sigui na mbeti ti John Dunlap.

en: Through the night between 150 and 200 copies were made, now known as "Dunlap broadsides".
sg: Na bingo, na popo ti 150 na 200 ta pande so a sara, fade so a hinga na iri ti "bordées Dunlap".

en: The first public reading of the document was by John Nixon in the yard of Independence Hall on July 8.
sg: Kozo tikongo mbeti so ayeke John Nixon la a sara ni na ya ti lacour ti dipandas na lango 8 nze ti Lêngao.

en: One was sent to George Washington on July 6, who had it read to his troops in New York on July 9. A copy reached London on August 10.
sg: Oko a tokua Georges Washington na lango 6 nze ti Lêngao, si lo diko na a turugu ti lo na New York na lango 9 nze ti Lêngao. Mbeni mara ni a tokua na Londres na lango 10 nze ti Koukourou.

en: The 25 Dunlap broadsides still known to exist are the oldest surviving copies of the document. The original handwritten copy has not survived.
sg: A bordé 25 ti Dunlap so a hinga ni na a gba ayeke a ngbere mbeti. Mbeni mara ni so a sara na mbeti na maboko a ngba ti la pepe.

en: Many paleontologists today believe that one group of dinosaurs survived and is alive today. We call them birds.
sg: A gba ti a wa gingo nda ti a ngbere a zo ala gbu li ti ala si a fa a tene mbeni hungo ti a donosaures a ngba lakoe na ala yeke da lakoe. I di iri ti ala a ndeke.

en: Many people don't think about them as dinosaurs because they have feathers and can fly.
sg: Azo mingi a mu ala tongana a dinosaure pepe tene ti so ala yeke na koa ti tere nga ala yeke huru.

en: But there are a lot of things about birds that still look like a dinosaur.
sg: A ye mingi a yeke na ndo ti a ndeke so a kpa dinosaure

en: They have feet with scales and claws, they lay eggs, and they walk on their two back legs like a T-Rex.
sg: Ala yeke na guere nga na écailles na a nzene, ala yeke du para, na ala yeke tambula na ndo ti guere ti ala ti peko use tongana T-Rex.

en: Virtually all computers in use today are based on the manipulation of information which is coded in the form of binary numbers.
sg: Biani a kambuta so ayeke sara na kusala fade so ayeke na ndo salango kusala ti a sango na lege ti kode so ayeke gbani.

en: A binary number can have only one of two values, i.e. 0 or 1, and these numbers are referred to as binary digits - or bits, to use computer jargon.
sg: A wungo ti binaire a lingbi ti wara gi ngere oko na popo ti use ni, so ti tene para wala oko, na a wungo so a iri ni wungo ti binaire - wala bits ti tene yanga ti informatique.

en: Internal poisoning may not be immediately apparent. Symptoms, such as vomiting are sufficiently general that an immediate diagnosis cannot be made.
sg: Sioni tonga tongana a gue na ya ti tere ayeke sara sioni hio. Ti hinga so ayeke sioni tonga, ayeke dengo, so alingbi awe ti tene gingo nda ye hio alingbi ti zi ani.

en: The best indication of internal poisoning may be the presence of an open container of medication or toxic household chemicals.
sg: Lege ti warango sioni tongo na ya ti tere ayeke na lege ti sembe ti yoro so yanga ni ayeke sengue wala sioni yoro so a yeke fa zo.

en: Check the label for specific first aid instructions for that specific poison.
sg: Ba mbeti ti tere ni ti hhinga kozo lege ti mungo ni tene ti sioni tonga so.

en: The term bug is used by entomologists in a formal sense for this group of insects.
sg: Yätï a yeke Lê tënë so a entomologistes a iri na kêtê nyama sô ayeke yängö.

en: This term derives from ancient familiarity with Bed-bugs, which are insects highly adapted to parasitize humans.
sg: Lê ti tënë so a yeke ngbêne särängö sëwä na a mandërë ti gbogbo, so a yeke a yätï so a yeke na ngangou ti nyö a zo.

en: Both Assassin-bugs and Bed-bugs are nidicolous, adapted to living in nest or housing of their host.
sg: A assassin-bugs na a mandërë ti gbogbo a dutï na finî na ya ti da ti a wayämbängö.

en: Across the United States of America, there are approximately 400,000 known cases of Multiple Sclerosis (MS), leaving it as the leading neurological disease in younger and middle aged adults.
sg: Na ti kodoro ti america, a ga nduru na 400 000 kpale ti scléros na plaques (SEP), ni la a sara kobela so a ndu li ti a kota zo na ala so ngu ti ala a kono kete.

en: MS is a disease that affects the central nervous system, which is made up of the brain, the spinal cord and the optic nerve.
sg: SEP ayeke kobela so ayeke gbu zo na li, ayeke bongbi aye tongana kpi ti li, fatuta ti ya ti biyo nga na sissa ti le.

en: Research has found that females are two times more likely to have MS then males.
sg: Gingo nda ye afa so a wali a yeke nduru fani use ti wara SEP a hon akoli.

en: A couple may decide it is not in their best interest, or in the interest of their child, to raise a baby.
sg: Koli na wali a lingbi ti ye da so ayeke na ya ti bango nzoni ti ala pepe, wala na ya ti bango nzoni ti molengue ti lo, ti bata mbeni foroto.

en: These couples may choose to make an adoption plan for their baby.
sg: Koli na wali so alingbi ti soro mbeni lege ti batango foroto ti ala.

en: In an adoption, the birth parents terminate their parental rights so that another couple may parent the child.
sg: Na ya ti mbeni batango zo, a sewa alingbi ti ke ndjia ti ala ti tene a mbeni koli na wali nde si alingbi bata molengue ni.

en: Science’s main goal is to figure out the way the world works through the scientific method. This method in fact guides most scientific research.
sg: Nda ti senda ye ayeke ti fa tongana nge dounia ayeke sara kousala na lege ti sendaye. Kode so a fa biani a gingo nda ye.

en: It isn’t alone though, experimentation, and an experiment is a test that is used to eliminate one or more of the possible hypotheses, asking questions, and making observations also guide scientific research.
sg: Ayeke oko pepe, hhingango ye, na mbeni hhingango kode a yeke mandako so a sara ti tene a futi oko wala gbati ti ye so zo ayegue gui ti hhinga, hunda ngo ndo na ba ngo ndo a mu lege nga na gingo senda ye.

en: Naturalists and philosophers focused on classical texts and, in particular, on the Bible in Latin.
sg: Wa gui ngo nda ye na wa gui ngo senda ndara ala gbu li ngangu na ndo sungo mbeti, nde, na ndo mbeti ti nzapa na yanga ti latin.

en: Accepted were Aristotle's views on all matters of science, including psychology.
sg: Bangondo ti Aristote na ndo a unda kue ti a snda kode, nga na ti snda sarango ye ti tere ti zo, a yeda na ni.

en: As knowledge of Greek declined, the West found itself cut off from its Greek philosophical and scientific roots.
sg: A hon keu hhingango ye ti a grec a kiri na peke, kodro ti occident a gue da ti kangbi na gunda ti senda ndara na senda kode ti grecques.

en: Many observed rhythms in physiology and behavior often crucially depend on the presence of endogenous cycles and their production through biological clocks.
sg: Gbati a ye mingi na ya senda bangondo nga na sarango ye ti tere ti zo alingbi na mayele ti nzoni na ye so alingui du ngo nga na lege ti ndu ngo ti zo.

en: Periodic rhythms, which are not simply responses to external periodic cues, have been documented for most living beings, including bacteria, fungi, plants, and animals.
sg: A ngoi ndende, sa ayeke sengue pepe ti kiringo tene na a kongo, a bongbi kue na ya buku ti gigi ti a zo, nga na a sene, a gugu, a keke nga na a nyama.

en: Biological clocks are self sustaining oscillators which will continue a period of free-running cycling even in the absence of external cues.
sg: Aye ti fa ngo ngbonga ayeke a ye ti wa ti dada so ngba ti gue na ngoi ti be ti ala tongana a ye ti fa ngo ni na gigi ayeke da pepe.

en: The Hershey and Chase experiment was one of the leading suggestions that DNA was a genetic material.
sg: Nda ye Hershey na Chase ayeke oko ti a ta unda ngo ye ti fa atene ADN a yeke mbeni gbakuru ti a ye ti tere ti zo.

en: Hershey and Chase used phages, or viruses, to implant their own DNA into a bacterium.
sg: Hershey na Chase a sara kousala na a makongo, ti yoro a ADN ti ala na ya tii mbeni sene.

en: They did two experiments marking either the DNA in the phage with a radioactive phosphorus or the protein of the phage with radioactive sulfur.
sg: Ala sala nda ye use so a fa ADN ti makongo, na phosphore radioctif, wala na nzoni mafuta ti makongo na soufre radioctif.

en: Mutations can have a variety of different effects depending on the type of mutation, the significance of the piece of genetic material affected and whether the cells affected are germ-line cells.
sg: A bian ngo tere a lingbi tii wara a ye ndende teti a biango tere, nzoni ti a kete gbakuru ti tere ti zo na tongana akete bumbu ti tere ti zo alingbi ti ko.

en: Only mutations in germ-line cells can be passed on to children, while mutations elsewhere can cause cell-death or cancer.
sg: Gi biango ti a ye ti tere ti zo alingbi tii mu lege na kongo si alingbi ti kangbi na a molengue, nga na mbage biango na gigi a lingbi ti sara si kui a ga wala cancer.

en: Nature-based tourism attracts people interested in visiting natural areas for the purpose of enjoying the scenery, including plant and animal wildlife.
sg: Pendere ndo na ya ndo a ngoto a zo so si a nzere na ala ti ba a ndo ti tene a la wara apendere ngonda, nga gbako nga na ndo batango a nyama.

en: Examples of on-site activities include hunting, fishing, photography, bird watching, and visiting parks and studying information about the ecosystem.
sg: A tapande ti kousala ti gingo nyama, gingo sussu, talato, bango a ndeke, bango nd ti batango a nyama ayeke mandango ye na lege ti a sango ti a ye ti gbako.

en: An example is visiting, photographing, and learning about organgatuangs in Borneo.
sg: Mbeni tapande ayeke bango ndo, talato, nga mandango a organgatuang na Bornéo.

en: Every morning, people leave small country towns in cars to go their workplace and are passed by others whose work destination is the place they have just left.
