sg: Ndaperere oko oko, a zo londo na a kete kodoro na kutukuu ti gue na ndo kusala ti ala ala tingbi tere na ala so a londo nga na ndo kusala ti kiri na a kete kodoro.

en: In this dynamic transport shuttle everyone is somehow connected with, and supporting, a transport system based on private cars.
sg: Na lege ti tambula so, a zo kue a yeda ti mu maboko na tambula na kutukutu.

en: Science now indicates that this massive carbon economy has dislodged the biosphere from one of its stable states that has supported human evolution for the past two million years.
sg: Senda ye a fa fad so konomi ti carbone a zi biosphere na dutingo ti o nzoni so a mu maboko na ma ngo na nduzu ti a zo na ya ti a ngu kutu use so a hon.

en: Everyone participates in society and uses transportation systems. Almost everyone complains about transportation systems.
sg: Zo kue a duti na societe na a sara a yekue ti tambula. Nduru a zo kue a yeke damba tene ti a yekue ti tambula.

en: In developed countries you seldom hear similar levels of complaints about water quality or bridges falling down.
sg: Na ya ti a kodoro so a mahi, ala yeke ma mingi ape a demba na ndo ti ngu wala ti ngo ti a gbagbara.

en: Why do transportation systems engender such complaints, why do they fail on a daily basis? Are transportation engineers just incompetent? Or is something more fundamental going on?
sg: Ngbanga ti nye a yeti transport a du a demba, ngbanga ti nye ala ti lakue? A wa kode kua ti transport ala hinga kua ti ala pepe? Wala mbeni ye so ayeke kete na gbeni a sara?

en: Traffic Flow is the study of the movement of individual drivers and vehicles between two points and the interactions they make with one another.
sg: Traffic Flow a yeke mandango ye ti a wa kpengo na kutukutu na a kukutuku ti zo mveni na popo ti a la oko oko.

en: Unfortunately, studying traffic flow is difficult because driver behavior cannot be predicted with one-hundred percent certainty.
sg: Sioni ni, mandango ye ti leguue a yeke ngangu gbanga ti so a wa kpengo na kutukutu alingbi pepe ti tene kozoni ayeke lege ni nzoni.

en: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave within a reasonably consistent range; thus, traffic streams tend to have some reasonable consistency and can be roughly represented mathematically.
sg: Nzoni ni, a wa kpengo na kutukutu a kpa ti duti nzoni na nzoni yengo da; tonga so, a yekue ti gbalekuma a kpa ti wara mbeni nzoni ta tene na alingbi ti kono ngangu na sungo guere konde.

en: To better represent traffic flow, relationships have been established between the three main characteristics: (1) flow, (2) density, and (3) velocity.
sg: Ti fa nzoni tambula ti gbalekuma, a hinga ngo tere a ba gigi na popo ti a ye ota: (1) tambula, (2) nengo (3) loro.

en: These relationships help in planning, design, and operations of roadway facilities.
sg: A hinga go tere so a woko lekere ngo guere ti ye, lekere ngo na sarango na kusala a gbakuru ti lege.

en: Insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly helped them evade enemies more easily and find food and mates more efficiently.
sg: A ngungu ayeke a kozo nyama so a huru. Ngangu ti hurungo ti ala a mu maboko na ala ti kpe hio na te ti a wato na ti wara kobe nga ti wara a fo ala ngangu mingi.

en: Most insects have the advantage of being able to fold their wings back along the body.
sg: Agba ti a ngungu a yek na passa ti kiri na kpangbi ti a la na ya ti tere ti ala.

en: This gives them a wider range of small places to hide from predators.
sg: So amu lege na ala ti hunzi tere ti ala na a kete ndo tene ti a nyama so ayeke te mba ti ala.

en: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.
sg: Laso, a ngungu so alingbi ti kiri na guere ti ala na ya ni pepe ayeke a libellule na a ephemere

en: Thousands of years ago, a man called Aristarchus said that the Solar System moved around the Sun.
sg: Na ya ti a gba ti ngu, mbeni koli iri ti lo Aristarque a tene La ayeke nguru na tere ti la.

en: Some people thought he was right but many people believed the opposite; that the Solar System moved around the Earth, including the Sun (and even the other stars).
sg: A mbeni zo mingi a gbu li atene lo tene ta tene a mbeni gbani nga a tene ayeke ni pepe; so la ayeke nguru na tere ti sese, nga na la ( na ni kue a mbeni tongolo).

en: This seems sensible, because the Earth doesn't feel as if it's moving, does it?
sg: So ayeke ta tene, tene ti so sese a kpa ti nguru pepe, ni la?

en: The Amazon River is the second longest and the biggest river on Earth. It carries more than 8 times as much water as the second biggest river.
sg: Ngu ti Amazone ayeke use yongoro nga na kuta ngu ti ndo le ssse. Lo hon na ngu fani 8 tongana use ngu so akono mingi.

en: The Amazon is also the widest river on Earth, at times six miles wide.
sg: Amazone ayeke nga ngu so a yeke nduru mingi na ndo sese, na mbeni nduru ni ti ake omana.

en: A full 20 percent of the water that pours out of the planet's rivers into the oceans comes from the Amazon.
sg: Nzoni 20 ti ngbangbo oko ti ngu so ayeke tuku na ya ti kete ngu na ya ti ngu ingo a ga na mbage ti Amazone.

en: The main Amazon River is 6,387 km (3,980 miles). It collects water from thousands of smaller rivers.
sg: Kuta ngu ti amazone ayeke na km 6 387 (3 980 miles). Lo wa ngu ti a gba ti a kete ngu.

en: Although pyramid-building in stone continued until the end of the Old Kingdom, the pyramids of Giza were never surpassed in their size and the technical excellence of their construction.
sg: Ndoni kue lekere ngo pyramide na tene ague ayo na nda ti ngbene Empire, a pyramide ti Gizeh a hon la oko pepe na yongo ti ala nzoni senda kode ti lekere ngo ye.

en: New Kingdom ancient Egyptians marvelled at their predecessors monuments, which were then well over a thousand year old.
sg: A ngbene Egyptiens ti fini Empire a nzere ala a limo ti ala so a hon kozo, so ala yeke na gba ti a ngu.

en: Vatican City's population is around 800. It is the smallest independent country in the world and the country with the lowest population.
sg: Azo ti kodoro ti Cité ti Vatican hungo ti ala a ga nduru na 800. ayeke kete kodoro ti dipanda na ya dunia nga kodoro so a zo ayeke da gba ni pepe.

en: Vatican City uses Italian in its legislation and official communications.
sg: Cité ti Vatican a sara italien na ya ti bada alezo nga na a tokua.

en: Italian is also the everyday language used by most of those who work in the state while Latin is often used in religious ceremonies.
sg: Nganga ti italien yanga ti kodoro so ayeke tene ni lakue na popo ti a ala so a sara kusala na leta si yanga ti latin a yeke tene na ya ti a matanga ti a da nzapa.

en: All citizens of Vatican City are Roman Catholic.
sg: A zo kue t cité Vatican ayee a mara ti catholiques romains

en: People have known about basic chemical elements such as gold, silver, and copper from antiquity, as these can all be discovered in nature in native form and are relatively simple to mine with primitive tools.
sg: A zo a hinga a ye so ayeke na gunda ti ye tongana lolo, nginza na cuivre ando guiriri, tene ti alingbi ti hinga ala kue na ya ti a ndo na tere ti ala a yeke sengue ti gboto na a bakuru ti ando.

en: Aristotle, a philosopher, theorised that everything is made up of a mixture of one or more of four elements. They were earth, water, air, and fire.
sg: Aristote, wa senda ndara, a fa atene yekue asara tongana gbian ngo ti ye oko wala gbani ti aye osio. Ala yeke sese, ngu, pupu na wa.

en: This was more like the four states of matter (in the same order): solid, liquid, gas, and plasma, though he also theorised that they change into new substances to form what we see.
sg: So a kpa pepe a ye ossio (na ya molongo): solide, liquide, gazeux na plasma, a hon kue so afa atene ala yeke gbian na fini aye ti ga ye so i yeke ba.

en: Alloys are basically a mixture of two or more metals. Don't forget that there are many elements on the periodic table.
sg: A alliage ayeke bongbi ngo ti ye use wala gba ti a wên. Ala girisa pepe so gba ti a ye ayeke na ndo tableau.

en: Elements like calcium and potassium are considered metals. Of course, there are also metals like silver and gold.
sg: A ye tongana calcium na na potasium a ba ala tongana a wên. Ta tene, a mbeni a wên ayeke da tongana nginza na lolo.

en: You can also have alloys that include small amounts of non-metallic elements like carbon.
sg: Ala pe ti wara a alliage so agonbgi akete wungo ti aye ti wên tongana carbone.

en: Everything in the Universe is made of matter. All matter is made of tiny particles called atoms.
sg: Ye kue na ya gigi a lekere na mbeni ye. A kete ye a yeke bongbi ti kete kete ye so ayeke nde a iri ni atomes.

en: Atoms are so incredibly tiny that trillions of them could fit into the period at the end of this sentence.
sg: A atome ahon gbungo li kete so a gba ni na popo ni alingbi ti gue nga da na nda ti ye so.

en: Thus, the pencil was a good friend to many people when it came out.
sg: Tongaso, keke mbeti ayeke nzoni ndeko teti a gba ti a zo tongana ala sigui.

en: Sadly, as newer methods of writing have emerged, the pencil has been relegated to lesser status and uses.
sg: Sioni ni, na ngoi so a fini ngobo ti sara ngo mbeti a ba gigii, keke mbeti a ga mbumbuse ye nga na a gba ti a zo so a sara na kusala kete.

en: People now write messages on computer screens, never having to come close to a sharpener.
sg: Azo a sara mbeti fade so na le ti kambuta, a wara la oko pepe ti ga nduru na tere ti aille-crayon.

en: One can only wonder what the keyboard will become when something newer comes along.
sg: E lingbi ti huna tere ti ye so clavien a yeke ga tongana mbeni fni ye a singui ande.

en: The fission bomb works on the principle that it takes energy to put together a nucleus with many protons and neutrons.
sg: A ye ti soungba ngo ti fission a sara kusala na ndo ti a ye so ngangu ni a bongbi na noyau ti ga gba ti a protons na a neutrons.

en: Sort of like rolling a heavy cart up a hill. Splitting the nucleus up again then releases some of that energy.
sg: Kete tongana pusu ngo charrette na ndo ti hoto. Kangbi ngo ti noyau na fini ni a zi mbage ti ngangu ni.

en: Some atoms have unstable nuclei which means that they tend to break apart with little or no nudging.
sg: Mbeni atom ayeke na a noyaux kirikiri, so aye ti fa atene ala ye ti kangbi na ni wala na a poussée pepe.

en: The surface of the Moon is made of rocks and dust. The outer layer of the Moon is called the crust.
sg: Ndo ti nzein a sara ni na tene nga na foukou sese. Ndo ti sese ti nzein na gigi a iri ni croûte.

en: The crust is about 70 km thick on the near side and 100 km thick on the far side.
sg: Croûte a ne nduru na km 70 ti tere ni nduru nga na km 100 ti mbegue ti tere ni.

en: It is thinner under the maria and thicker under the highlands.
sg: ala yeke kete na gbe ti maria na a ne na gbe ti yongoro sese

en: There may be more maria on the near side because the crust is thinner. It was easier for lava to rise up to the surface.
sg: Alingbi ti wara gbati maria na tere ni nduru tene ti so croûte a yeke kete. Ala yeke yeke ti mah na ndoni.

en: Content theories are centered on finding what makes people tick or appeals to them.
sg: A ye ti yani a duti na ndo be ti gingo ye so a yapu a zo ti tene a ba ala.

en: These theories suggest that people have certain needs and/or desires which have been internalized as they mature to adulthood.
sg: Fango ye a tene a zo aye mbeni ye na wala nzara ti ga ti tene ala kpigba juska ala gua kota zo.

en: These theories look at what it is about certain people that make them want the things that they do and what things in their environment will make them do or not do certain things.
sg: A sarango ye so a gui ti hinga so na ambeni zo a mu nzara ti ye so ala yeke sara na a ye so na ya ti ndo ti ala a sara wala a sara pepe a mbeni ye.

en: Two popular content theories are Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs Theory and Hertzberg's Two Factor Theory.
sg: Sarango ye use na le ti a zo ayeke sarango ti kota ni ti a nzara ti Maslow na sarango use ti facteurs Hertzberg.

en: Generally speaking, two behaviors can emerge as managers begin to lead their former peers. One end of the spectrum is trying to remain “one of the guys” (or gals).
sg: Na ndo ni kue, ngobo use a lingbi ti mai tongana a kota azo a tonda ti bata a kpere ni. Mbeni tere ti spectre a tara ti ngba "zo oko" (wala a masseka)

en: This type of manager has difficulty making unpopular decisions, performing disciplinary action, performance evaluations, assigning responsibility, and holding people accountable.
sg: Wa konde so a yeke na kpale ti mu a yanga, ti gboto min na lege ti andia, ti ba ngangu ti a zo, ti kangbi kusala na ti zi a zo na ndo kusala.

en: At the other end of the spectrum, one morphs into an unrecognizable individual that feels he or she must change everything the team has been doing and make it their own.
sg: Na mbeni tere ti spectre, i yeke bian ti ga mbeni zo so a hinga lo pepe so lo yeke na mawa ti tene lo bian a bongbi kue.

en: After all, the leader is ultimately responsible for the success and failure of the team.
sg: Na peko ni kue,zo ti li ni a yeke wa ti so ngo benda nga na ti tingo ti a bongbi.

en: This behavior oftentimes results in rifts between the leaders and the rest of the team.
sg: A sarango ye tonga so a yeke ga na kangbi na popo ti a zo ti li ni nga na tanga ti a bongbi.

en: Virtual teams are held to the same standards of excellence as conventional teams, but there are subtle differences.
sg: Abongbi so ahinga ala pepe a mu ala lege oko tongana a bongbi ti mbiri mbiri, ahon kue ala yeke nde nde.

en: Virtual team members often function as the point of contact for their immediate physical group.
sg: A la so ayeke na ya ti bongbi so a hinga ni pepe ala yeke lakue na mbni ndo ti tingbi tene ti a bongbi ngo ti ala hio.

en: They often have more autonomy than conventional team members as their teams may meet according to varying time zones which may not be understood by their local management.
sg: Ala yeke nga na ngangu na hon ala ti nzoni bongbi tene ti zo a bongbi ti ala alingbi ti wara tere na lege ti a ngbonga so a bian e alingbi ti tene pepe a hinga lege ti ala.

en: The presence of a true “invisible team” (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p109) is also a unique component of a virtual team.
sg: Dutingo ti nzoni "equipe invisible" (Larson na Lafasto, 1989, p109) a yeke nga bongbingo ti mbeni bongbi so a hinga ni pepe.

en: The “invisible team” is the management team to which each of the members report. The invisible team sets the standards for each member.
sg: "Kundu ti azo so ahunzi tere" ayeke bongbi ti fango ye so na ya ni a zo oko oko ayeke. Kundu ti azo so ahunzi tere a lekere a ye ti mbilimbili tene ti a zo so a ko na ya ni.

en: Why would an organization want to go through the time consuming process of establishing a learning organization? One goal for putting organizational learning concepts into practice is innovation.
sg: Ngbanga ti nye kundu aye ti gue na nzoni lege za na sese abongbi oko ti azo ndali ti manda aye? Sarango fini ye ayeke akusara ti sara kua na ndo ti atene ti mandago ye ti abongbi ni.

en: When all available resources are effectively used across the functional departments of an organization, creativity and ingenuity can transpire.
sg: Tongana aye kue ti mungo maboko asara yani awe na andokua nde nde ti abongbi, lekengo fini ye ngana ndara ti sarango mbeni aye ape ti sigi na le ti azo kue.

en: As a result, the process of an organization working together to overcome an obstacle can lead to a new innovative process to serve the customer's need.
sg: Ni lâa, lege ti sarango ti abongbi asara kua legeoko ti sigi na mbeni kpalé ape ti mu fini lege ti kua ndali ti kiri tene na hunda ti a client.

en: Before an organization can be innovative, leadership must create a culture of innovation as well as shared knowledge and organizational learning.
sg: Kozo abongbi a za ye ti fini, leadership ayeke zi lege na mara ye nde nde ti fini nga na vungango ti hingango nga na mandango ye ti abongbi ni.

en: Angel (2006), explains the Continuum approach as a method being used to help organizations reach a higher level of performance.
sg: Angel (2006), fa approche Continuum tongana kusara oko zia da ndali ti mu maboko na abongbi ti si nzoni niveau ti ndara zo ahon mingi.

en: Neurobiological data provide physical evidence for a theoretical approach to the investigation of cognition. Therefore it narrows the research area and makes it much more exact.
sg: Asango ti neurologie afa aye so ti physique ti nduru tene ti tara ti ba gbungo li ti zo. Ni lâa, lo sara si gingo gingo ye aga kete nga na asara si ague na lege ni.

en: The correlation between brain pathology and behaviour supports scientists in their research.
sg: Kua na popo ti ala pathologie cérébrale nga na dutingo amu maboko na Awasenda ye na gingo gingo ti ala.

en: It has been known for a long time that different types of brain damage, traumas, lesions, and tumours affect behaviour and cause changes in some mental functions.
sg: E hinga londo la ni so mara fango ti li ayeke nde nde, ti traumatisme, ti fango nga na tumeur asara kpale na sârângö yë nga na aga na bïängbï na mbeni sarango ti gbungbo li ti zo.

en: The rise of new technologies allows us to see and investigate brain structures and processes never seen before.
sg: Sigingo ti ala fini a kode amu lege na e ti ba nga na manda a structure nga na a sarango ti li so zo oko aba pepe kozo ni.

en: This provides us with a lot of information and material to build simulation models which help us to understand processes in our mind.
sg: Aga na e gbati asango nga ti gbakuru ti leke amara ti simulation so ake mu maboko na e ti manda sarango ti gbungbo li ti e.

en: Although AI has a strong connotation of science fiction, AI forms a very important branch of computer science, dealing with behavior, learning and intelligent adaptation in a machine.
sg: Atâa IA yeke tene ti nganu mingi na science-fiction, IA ayeke ndokua ti kusara so ayeke ngangu ti informatique, adiko dutingo ti azo, mandango ye nga na tara ti hhinga aye ti ndara ti masini.

en: Research in AI involves making machines to automate tasks that require intelligent behavior.
sg: Gingo ti IA afa ti lekengo a machine ti sara si akusara kue ahunda ndara a ga automatique.

en: Examples include control, planning and scheduling, the ability to answer customer diagnoses and questions, as well as handwriting recognition, voice and face.
sg: Atapande amu fango ye, hhhingango ye nga na zia da mbeni ye na sese, ndara ti kiri tene na a diagnostic nga na hunda ti a clients, nga na hhhingango ti sunbo ye na maboko, go nga na le.

en: Such things have become separate disciplines, which focus on providing solutions to real life problems.
sg: Ambeni ye so aga amandango ye nde, so abongbi na ndo ti agbakuru ti solution na akpalé ti gigi so ayeke tatene.

en: The AI ​​system is now often used in the fields of economics, medicine, engineering and the military, as has been built in several home computer and video game software applications.
sg: Système ti IA ayeke fadeso na kusara ti buze, wanganga, kode nga na kundu ti aturugu, lege so azi ada yani na gbati application logicielle ti ordinateur ti da nga na angia ti limo.

en: Field trips are a large part of any classroom. Quite often a teacher would love to take her students places to which a bus trip is not an option.
sg: Guengo na ndo ti gigi ayeke koyt aye ti classe kue. Mingi awafango mbeti aye ti gue na awamandango mbeti ti lo na mbeni ando, la ni guengo na kara ayeke nzoni lege ti soro pepe.

en: Technology offers the solution with virtual field trips. Students can look at museum artifacts, visit an aquarium, or admire beautiful art while sitting with their class.
sg: Fini kode mu lege ti fa solution na bango ando na Internet. Awamandngo mbeti ape ti ba a artefact ti musée, ba aquarium wala gonda pendere aye nde nde dutingo na classe ni.

en: Sharing a field trip virtually is also a great way to reflect a on a trip and share experiences with future classes.
sg: Kangbï guengo mbeni ndo na lege ti internet ayeke nzoni lege ti gbu li ti mo na guengo gene nga na kangbï ahingango ye na awamandango mbeti ti kekereke.

en: For example, each year students from Bennet School in North Carolina design a website about their trip to the State Capital, each year the website gets remodeled, but old versions are kept online to serve as a scrapbook.
sg: Tapande, na yati ngu oko, awamandango ti Bennet School na Caroline ti Banga ala sara site Web na guengo gene ti ala na sese kodoro ti Letâa, na yati ngu oko, amai site web, me angbere ye, abata ni na internet teti lekengo album.

en: Blogs can also help improve student writing. While students often begin their blog experience with sloppy grammar and spelling, the presence of an audience generally changes that.
sg: A blog ape ti mule lege na awambandango mbeti ti mai na sungo mbeti ti ala. Atâa awamandango mbeti atondani hingango ti ala na ndo ti blog na grammaire nga na abuba atene, sigingo ti azo abian mingi aye ni so.

en: Since students are often the most critical audience, the blog writer begins to strive to improve writing to avoid criticism.
sg: Na aye so awafango mbeti ayeke na azo so le ti azo kue ayeke ne ndo ti ala, lo so lo sara blog lo tonda ni ti sara ngangu ti mai sungo mbeti ti lo ti kpe sioni tene na ndo ni.

en: Also blogging "forces students to become more savvy about the world around them." The need to feed the interest of the audience inspires students to be clever and interesting (Toto, 2004).
sg: Ahon ye kue, a blog "amu lege na awamandango mbeti ti hinga nzoni dunia so angourou ala". Nzara zia lege na nzoni dutingo ti azo kue amu ngangu na awamandango mbeti ti duti na ndara nga na nzoni (Toto, 2004).

en: Blogging is a tool that inspires collaboration, and encourages students to extend learning well beyond the traditional school day.
sg: Blogging ayeke kusara so afa bongbi nga na ngangu ti awamandango mbeti ti gue na mandango mbeti ti ala yongoro ahon lango ti ngbere dikongo mbeti ni.

en: Appropriate use of blogs "can empower students to become more analytical and critical; through actively responding to Internet materials, students can define their positions in the context of others' writings as well as outline their own perspectives on particular issues (Oravec, 2002).
sg: Nzoni sarango ti a blog "ape mu lege na awamandango mbeti ti aye kue na le ti gingo mbeni ye nga na pika patara na ndo ti aye; na ya ti kiringo tene na ambeti ti Internet, awamandango mbeti ape ti hinga dutingo ti ala ndali ti atokwa ti azo nde nga na fa bango ye ti kekereke ti ala na ndo ti ahunda so ayeke nde (Oravec, 2002).

en: Ottawa is Canada's charming, bilingual capital and features an array of art galleries and museums that showcase Canada's past and present.
sg: Ottawa ayeke pendere kodoro sese ti yanga use ti Canada nga na ayeke pendere galerie ti art nga na musée so a mu nengo ti ngbere nga na laso dutingo ti Canada.

en: Farther south is Niagara Falls and the north is home to the untapped natural beauty of the Muskoka and beyond.
sg: Na mbage ti mbongo ahon ayeke na a chute ti Niagara nga na banga e yeke ba pendere ndo ti so ade ala li da pepe ti Muskoka nga na ahon.

en: All these things and more highlight Ontario as what is considered quintessentially Canadian by outsiders.
sg: Azo ti wande atene, aye kue nga na mbeni aye afa Ontario tongana akpa azo ti Canada

en: Large areas further north are quite sparsely populated and some is nearly uninhabited wilderness.
sg: Kota ando na banga azo ayeke mingi pepe nga na ambeni ala yeke kota ando ti abasenzi zo alango da pepe.

en: For a comparison of population that surprises many: There are more African Americans living in the US than there are Canadian citizens.
sg: Mbeni ye ahon gbungoli ti e tongana e ba azo yati ndo ni: wungo ti Afro-Americain alango na Amerika ahon azo ti Canada.

en: The East African Islands are in the Indian Ocean off the eastern coast of Africa.
sg: Azua ti Afrika ti Tô ayeke na ndo ti Ngu ingo ti Inde, na kota mbutu sese ti do ti Afrika.

en: Madagascar is by far the biggest, and a continent on its own when it comes to wildlife.
sg: Madagascar ayeke na yongoro kota ahon ngana continent na mbage nde na ye so aba mara ti anyama so ayeke da ka.

en: Most of the smaller islands are independent nations, or associated with France, and known as luxury beach resorts.
sg: Gbati akete zûa ayeke kodoro so ayeke yamba, wala abongbi na azo ti Falanzi, nga na ahinga ala na iri ti pendere station balnéaires.

en: The Arabs also brought Islam to the lands, and it took in a big way in the Comoros and Mayotte.
sg: Arabes ague na nzapa ti islam na asese, nga na aye a mu gbati ando na Comores nga na Mayotte.

en: European influence and colonialism began in the 15th century, as Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama found the Cape Route from Europe to India.
sg: Dutingo gbia ti azo ti poto nga na colonialisme atondani na ngungbangbo 15, na ngoi so wa gingo gingo ti Portugal Vasco de Gama lo ba lege ti Cap na popo ti Poto nga na Inde.

en: In the north the region is bounded by the Sahel, and in the south and west by the Atlantic Ocean.
sg: Na banga, gbakodoro so akangbi na Sahel, nga na mbongo ngana do na ngu ingo ti Atlantique.

en: Women: It is recommended that any women travellers say that they are married, regardless of actual marital status.
sg: Awali: ahunda na awali kue ague gene ti fa ti tene ala kata seleka na koli, atâa dutingo ti wali na ti koli ti lo.

en: It is helpful to also wear a ring (just not one that looks too expensive.
sg: Ayeke nzoni ti yû bâge (me bâge ti ngere kete).

en: Women should realize that cultural differences may result in what they would consider harassment and it is not uncommon to be followed, grabbed by the arm, etc.
sg: Awali ala du a ti hinga amara ye nde nde ape ti ga na aye so ayeke gbu zo na ngangu nga na azo ape ti gue na peko ti mo, ti gbu mo na maboko, na mbeni ye nde nde.

en: Be firm in turning down men, and don't be afraid to stand your ground (cultural differences or not, it doesn't make it ok!).
sg: Ala kanga tere ti ala biani tongana ala këin akoli nga na la sara mbëtö pepe ti luti na tene ti ala (mara ye aduti nde nde wa apëe, ague nzoni pepe!).

en: The modern city of Casablanca was founded by Berber fishermen in the 10th century BCE, and was used by the Phoenicians, Romans, and the Merenids as a strategic port called Anfa.
sg: Fini kodoro ti Casablanca aba gigi na azo ti gingo susu ti berbère na ngugbangbo 10 kozo gango ngoi ti e nga na azo ti Phénice, ti Rome alango ka nga na Mérénide agba port stratégique a iri Anfa

en: The Portuguese destroyed it and rebuilt it under the name Casa Branca, only to abandon it after an earthquake in 1755.
sg: Azo ti Portugal abuba ya ni nga na ala leke na iri ti Casa Branca, ti zia yani na peko ti gbugburu ti sese na ngu 1755.

en: The Moroccan sultan rebuilt the city as Daru l-Badya and it was given the name Casablanca by Spanish traders who established trading bases there.
sg: Sultan ti Maroc aleke gbata na iri ti Darul-Badya nga lo mu na lo iri ti Casablanca na lege ti adebuze ti Espanye so a zia da ka agündâ da ti buze.

en: Casablanca is one of the least interesting places to shop in all of Morocco.
sg: Casablanca ayeke oko na popo ti ando so azo aye mingi pepe ti gue sara gara na Maroc kue.

en: Around the old Medina it's easy to find places selling traditional Moroccan goods, such as tagines, pottery, leather goods, hookahs, and a whole spectrum of geegaws, but it's all for the tourists.
sg: Na yati ngbere médina, mo yeke wara hion ando so aka agbeere kungba ti Maroc, tongana tajines, poterie, maroquinerie, narguilés ng na mara ti a éventail ti geegaws kwe, me so kue alingbi na a touriste.

en: Goma is a tourist city of the Democratic Republic of Congo in the extreme east near Rwanda.
sg: Goma ayeke kodoro so si azo ti wande aye ti ba mingi na Kodoro ti République Démocratique ti Congo na mbage ti tô nduru na kodoro ti Rwanda.

en: In 2002 Goma was destroyed by lava from the Nyiragongo volcano which buried most of the town’s streets, particularly the town centre.
sg: Na ngu 2002, wa ti volcan ti Nyirangongo abuba kodoro ti Goma so agbi alege ti gbata ngangu, mingi be ti kodoro ti Goma ni.

en: While Goma is reasonably safe, any visits outside of Goma should be researched to understand the state of the fighting that persists in the North Kivu province.
sg: Goma ayeke nzoni kodoro tatene, guengo na gigi ti kodoro ti Goma mo du a ti manda nzoni si ndani ti atiringo bira so a ngba ti gue na gbata ti Kivu ti Banga.

en: The city is also the base to climb the Nyiragongo volcano along with some of the cheapest Mountain Gorilla tracking in Africa.
sg: A gbata kue ayeke ndo ti guengo ba li ti hoto ti volcan ti Nyiragongo nga na bango ti kota makaku a iri Gorille ti ahoto so a yeke na kete angere na ndo ti Afrika.

en: You can use boda-boda (motorcycle taxi) to get around Goma. The normal (local) price is ~500 Congolese Francs for the short ride.
sg: Mo lingbi ti mu boda-bota (kpururu) ti tambula na Goma. Ngere so azo a hinga ake 500 francs congolais ti tambula kete.

en: Combined with its relative inaccessibility, "Timbuktu" has come to be used as a metaphor for exotic, distant lands.
sg: Abongbi na hio lingo ti lo "Tombouctou" aga ndo ti tene ti apendere sese nga na yongoro.

en: Today, Timbuktu is an impoverished town, although its reputation makes it a tourist attraction, and it has an airport.
sg: Laso, Tombouctou ayeke gbata ti azo ti Yërë, atâa so hingango-ndo ti asara si gbati touriste ague ka nga na lo yeke na aéroport.

en: In 1990, it was added to the list of world heritage sites in danger, due to the threat of desert sands.
sg: Na ngu 1990, azi da na iri ti a site ti akungba ti dunia ague ti buba, ndali ti sigingo ti mbutu ti bürû.

en: It was one of the major stops during Henry Louis Gates' PBS special Wonders of the African World.
sg: Ayeke oko na popo ti a kozo alege nde ti PBS Wonders of the African World ti Henry Louis Gates.

en: The city is in stark contrast to the rest of the country's cities, because it has more of an Arabic flair than of an African.
sg: Gbata akanga tere na tangani agbata ti kodoro, ndali ti mara dutingo ti akpa lo ti arabe nga na ti Afrika.

en: The Kruger National Park (KNP) lies in the north-east of South Africa and runs along the border of Mozambique in the east, Zimbabwe in the north, and the southern border is the Crocodile River.
sg: Parc ti kodoro ti Kruger (KNP) ayeke na mbage ti banga-tô ti Afrika ti Mbongo nga na ague na yanga ti kodoro akangbi Mozambique na tô, Zimbabwe na banga, nga na yanga ti kodoro ti banga ayeke kota ngu a iri Crocodile.

en: The park covers 19,500 km² and is divided in 14 different ecozones, each supporting different wildlife.
sg: Parc amu km² 19 500 ti ndo nga na kangbi na ya ti écozone 14 nde nde, oko oko abongbi mara ti anyama nde nde.

en: It is one of the main attractions of South Africa and it is considered the flagship of South African National Parks (SANParks).
sg: Ayekeoko na popo ti a kozo angia so abongbi gbati azo ti Afgrika ti Mbongo nga na atene ayeke fleuron ti a parcs ti kodoro ti Afrika ti Mbongo kue (SANParks).

en: As with all South African National Parks, there are daily conservation and entry fees for the park.
sg: Tongana a parc ti kodoro ti Afrika ti Mongo kue, ayeke na nginza ti batango ye ngan ti li lango kue na parc ni.

en: It may also be beneficial for one to buy a Wild Card, which provides entry to either selections of parks in South Africa or all of the South African National Parks.
sg: Ayeke nzoni mingi ti vo Wild Card, so ake mu lege na mo ti soro parc ti Afrika ti Mbongo wala a parc ti kodoro kue ti azo ti Afrika ti Mbongo.

en: Hong Kong Island gives the territory of Hong Kong its name and is the place that many tourists regard as the main focus.
sg: Zûa ti Hong Kong amu iri na nso ti Hong Kong nga na ayeke ndo so agbati touriste aba tongana kozo ndo so ala du a ti gue ni.

en: The parade of buildings that make the Hong Kong skyline has been likened to a glittering bar chart that is made apparent by the presence of the waters of Victoria Harbour.
sg: Bango ada so ayeke na yongöro ti horizon ti Hong Kong nî akpa graphique ti barres so afa la so asara kua na sigingo ti a ngu ti port ti Victoria.

en: To get the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head for the Kowloon waterfront opposite.
sg: Ti yengo ti ba mbeni pendere aye ti Hong Kong, ala londo na zua ngana ala gue na dawan ti ngu ingi ti Kowloon na lutingo na le ti lo.

en: The great majority of Hong Kong Island's urban development is densely packed on reclaimed land along the northern shore.
sg: Gbati maingo ti kete kodoro ti zûa ti Hong Kong ayeke na ndoni asese so azo a mu na mbage ti mbutu sese ti banga.

en: This is the place the British colonisers took as their own and so if you are looking for evidence of the territory's colonial past, this is a good place to start.
sg: Ayeke ndo so azo ti mungo sese ti Angelëe a mu ni nga na tongana ala gi mbeni ye afa ti ngbere mungo kodoro na azo wande, ayeke nzoni lege to tondani sara aye.

en: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast.
sg: Sundarbans ayeke kota Kämbûsu ti a mangroves littoral ti dunia, amu km 80 (50 mi) na kete kodoro ti Bangladesh nga na azo ti Inde londo na mbage ti sese ti ngu.

en: The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park.
sg: Atene Sundarban ayeke bage ti kungba ti dunia ti UNESCO. Mbage ti yaka so ayeke na ndo ti azo ti Inde a iri ni parc ti kodoro ti Sundarbans.

en: The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain.
sg: Ayaka ayeke gi mangrove pepe, ayeke na tangani a ngangu anyama ti yaka so amu kozo kota ndo ti mbutu sese ti Gange.

en: The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas.
sg: Ndo ti Sundarban a mu superficie km² 3 850, nga na ndambo ti ota ti ndo ni ayeke na ngu/père.

en: Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
sg: Londo ngu 1966m Sundarban ayeke na kota ndo so anyma alango da nga na atene fadeso ayeke na a tigres 400 ti gbia ti Bengale nga na 30 000 cerf ayeke na nzoroko na gbakodoro ni.

en: Buses depart the inter-district bus station (across the river) throughout the day, though most, especially those heading to the east and Jakar/Bumthang leave between 06:30 and 07:30.
sg: Akara a gue na ndo ti lutingo ti akutukutu inter-district (na mbage nde ti kota ngu) lango kue, atâa, mingi na popo ti ala ague na mbage ti tô nga na Jakar/Bumthang, ague na popo ti a 06h30 nga na 07h30.

en: As the inter-district buses are often full, it is advisable to purchase a ticket a few days in advance.
sg: A kara na popo ti avaka ayeke ayon gbati azo, mo du a ti vo ticket kozo akete alango si ahon.

en: Most districts are served by small Japanese Coaster Buses, which are comfortable and sturdy.
sg: Mingi avaka akete kara ti azo ti Japon Coaster , nzoni dutingo nga na akono a gue ka.

en: Shared taxis are a quick and comfortable means to travel to nearby places, such as Paro (Nu 150) and Punakha (Nu 200).
sg: A taxis so abongbi azo ayeke hio lege nga na dutingo nzoni ti gue na nduru ando, tongana Paro (Nu 150) nga na Punakha (Nu 200).

en: The Oyapock River Bridge is a cable-stayed bridge. It spans the Oyapock River to link the cities of Oiapoque in Brazil and Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock in French Guiana.
sg: A gbagbara Ngu ti Oyapock ayeke gbagbara so teti singa. Alondo na Ngu ti Oyapock nga na a gue ti si na agbata ti Oiapoque na Brasil nga na Saint Georges ti Oyapock na Guyanne ti Falanzi.

en: The two towers rise to a height of 83 meters, it's 378 meters long and it has two lanes of 3.50 m wide.
sg: Akota da use a yongoro metre 83, na yongoro ametre 378 nga na ayeke na kete alege ti a metre 3,50 .

en: The vertical clearance under the bridge is 15 meters. Construction was completed in August 2011, it didn't open to traffic until March 2017.
sg: A ndo ti gbe ti gbagbara ayeke na ametre 15. Lekengo ye ni a hunzi na nze ti koukourou ngu 2011, azi lege na tambula ti akutukutu pepe tii na nze ti Mbango 2017.

en: The bridge is scheduled to be fully operational in September 2017, when the Brazilian customs checkpoints are expected to be finished.
sg: Atene a gbagbara ni ayeke zi lege kue na azo wala na akutukutu na nze ti Mvouka 2017, na ngoi so ala ke hunzi biani lekengo a da ti ndokua ti kusala ti kiri ti Brasil so ayeke baa nzoni mbeti ti kutukutuazo nga ti azo.

en: The Guaraní were the most significant indigenous group inhabiting what is now Eastern Paraguay, living as semi-nomadic hunters who also practised subsistence agriculture.
sg: Guarani angba kundu ti kozo azo ti bansenzi alango na ndo so a iri laso Paraguay ti Tô, ala lango da tongana azo ti fango anyama so ayeke gue na kete ngoi ti tambula na ando nde nde a hinga ala azo ti fango yaka kue.

en: The Chaco region was home to other groups of indigenous tribes such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who survived by hunting, gathering and fishing.
sg: Agba kodoro ti Chaco ayeke da ti mbeni akundu ti amara tongana Guaycurú ngana Payaguá so a duti ka na fango anyama, bongbi nga na gingo a susu.

en: In the 16th century Paraguay, formerly called "The Giant Province of the Indies", was born as a result of the encounter of Spanish conquerors with the native indigenous groups.
sg: Na ya ti ngûngbangbo 16 Paraguay, so kozo iri ti lo ayeke "Kota a Province ti azo ti Inde" a baa gigi ndali ti warango tere na aturugu ti bira ti Espagne legeoko na akundu ti azo ti bansenzi ti kodoro.

en: The Spaniards started the colonization period which lasted for three centuries.
sg: Azo ti Espagnol atondani ngoi so duti na sese ti gbia ti wande so aninga agûngbangbo ota.

en: Since the foundation of Asunción in 1537, Paraguay has managed to keep a lot of its indigenous character and identity.
sg: Londo bango a gigi ti Asuncion na 1537, Paraguay lo bata gbati dutingo nga na sarango ye ti azo ti bansenzi.

en: Argentina is well known for having one of the best polo teams and players in the world.
sg: ahinga kodoro ti Argentine nzoni mingi ndali ti pendere akundu ti polo nga na pendere azo ti pikango ndembo ti gere na ahon kue na dunia.

en: The largest tournament of the year takes place in December at the polo fields in Las Cañitas.
sg: Kota a mandako ti ngu a mu ndo na nze ti Kakaouka na ndo ti polo na Las Cañitas.

en: Smaller tournaments and matches can also be seen here at other times of the year.
sg: Ala pe ti baa kete amandako nga na andembo ge so na mbeni angoi ti ngu.

en: For news on tournaments and where to buy tickets for polo matches, check Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
sg: Ti fangosango ti amandako nga na ndo ti vo a ticket ndali ti ngia ti ndembo, ala baa Abongbi ti Artgentine ti ndembo.

en: The official Falklands currency is the Falkland pound (FKP) whose value is set equivalent to that of one British pound (GBP).
sg: Nginza ti kodoro ti kodoro ti Malouin ayeke livre Malouine (FKP) na nengo ti lo akpa livre ti sterling ti (BGP).

en: Money can be exchanged at the only bank in the islands which is located in Stanley across from the FIC West store.
sg: A peti bian nginza gi na oko da ti mosoro na azua so ayeke na Stanley na mbage ti debuze ti FIC West.

en: British pounds will generally be accepted anywhere in the islands and within Stanley credit cards and United States dollars are also often accepted.
sg: Ala ke ye da nginza ti azo ti Angleterre na ando kue na azua nga na carte ti credit ti Stanley ngan a dollar ti Etats Unis kue.

en: On the outlying islands credit cards will probably not be accepted, although British and United States currency may be taken; check with the owners in advance to determine what is an acceptable payment method.
sg: Na ndo ti azua so angourou ya ni, ape ti ye da carte ti pepe, atâa nginza ti aAzo ti Angelëe nga na Amerika azo aye da yani, ala ba nzoni na azo so ando ayeke ti ala kozo ti fa lege ti futango nginza wa ala pe ti ye da.

en: It is nearly impossible to exchange Falklands currency outside of the islands, so exchange money prior to leaving the islands.
sg: Mo pe ti bian nginza ti Falklands na gigi ti azua pepe, ni la bian nginza ti mo biani kozo mo londona azua.

en: Since Montevideo is south of the Equator, it is summer there when it's winter in the Northern Hemisphere and vice versa.
sg: Londo ngoi so Montevideo ayeke na bongo ti equateurayeke été ka nga na hiver na hémisphère ti banga nga na vice versa.

en: Montevideo is in the subtropics; in the summer months, temperatures above +30°C are common.
sg: Montevideo ayeke na ando ti tropique ti bongo; na anze ti ngoi ti été e baa mingi a sêndowâ ni a na nduzu ti +30°C.

en: The winter can be deceptively chilly: temperatures rarely go below freezing, but the wind and humidity combine to make it feel colder than what the thermometer says.
sg: Hiver a pe ti sarade mingi: asêndowâ a ti na gbe ti pärä mingi pepe, me a pupu nga na humidité agongbi ti sara si de a ga ngangu ahon ti atene ti thermometre.

en: There are no particular "rainy" and "dry" seasons: the amount of rain stays roughly the same throughout the year.
sg: Angoi ti "ngu" nga na ti "buru" ayeke nde pepe: a wungo ti ngu agnba gi senge na yati ngu kue.

en: Though many of the animals in the park are used to seeing humans, the wildlife is nonetheless wild and should not be fed or disturbed.
sg: Atâa gbati anyama ti parc a baa azo gi lakue lakue, a yaka ti anyama ayeke ndo ti anyama so alango na gigi nga na zo ape ti mu kobe na ala wala sara kpale na ala pepe.

en: According to park authorities, stay at least 100 yards/meters away from bears and wolves and 25 yards/meters from all other wild animals!
sg: Kota azo ti parc atene azo adu a ti luti yongoro na ametre 100 ti ndo so ours nga na nyama akpa mbo nga na ametre 25 ndo so tangani anyama ti gigi so ayeke da!

en: No matter how docile they may look, bison, elk, moose, bears, and nearly all large animals can attack.
sg: Atâa lege so kue so ala pe ti du ti kpo na le ti ala, abison, awapitis, a orignaux, a ours nga na tangani kota anyama kue a pe ti gi ti fa zo.

en: Each year, dozens of visitors are injured because they didn't keep a proper distance. These animals are large, wild, and potentially dangerous, so give them their space.
sg: Lakue na fini ngu, agene balë ôko a kä ndali ti so ala bata nzoni yongo pepe. Anyama so ayeke kota, alango na gigi nga na akpengba, ni la ala mu na ala ndo ti ala.

en: In addition, be aware that odors attract bears and other wildlife, so avoid carrying or cooking odorous foods and keep a clean camp.
sg: Ahon kue, mo hinga nzoni si fungo ye asara si a ours nga na mbeni anyama ti gigi aga nduru na mo, ni la mo yo ala pepe wala to kobo so a fufungo nga na mo bata ndo ti gigi ti lango ti mo sëni.

en: Apia is the capital of Samoa. The town is on the island of Upolu and has a population of just under 40,000.
sg: Apia ayeke kodoro sese ti Samoa. Gabta ni ayeke na ndo ti zûa ti Upolu nga na ayeke na kete azo 40 000 alango ka.

en: Apia was founded in the 1850s and has been the official capital of Samoa since 1959.
sg: Apia a ba gigi na angu 1850 nga na ayeke kodoro sese ti Samoa londo ngu 1959.

en: The harbor was the site of an infamous naval standoff in 1889 when seven ships from Germany, the US, and Britain refused to leave the harbor.
sg: Ndo ti ngu ti amangboko a wara sioni pkale ti ngû azo kwe ahinga na ngu 1889 na ngoi so amangboko mbâsâmbâlâ ti Zâmani, ti Etats-Unis nga na ti Grande Bretagne a këin ti londo na ndo ni.

en: All the ships were sunk, except for one British cruiser. Nearly 200 American and German lives were lost.
sg: Amangboko kue a li na ya ti ngu, agba gi oko ti azo Grande Bretagne. A si azo 200 ti Amérika nga na ti Zâmani akui.

en: During the struggle for independence organised by the Mau movement, a peaceful gathering in the town resulted in the killing of the paramount chief Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.
sg: Tiringo bira ndali ti duti kodoro yamba so kundu ti Mau asara ni, abongbi ti azo ti siriri na ya ti gbata ni asi na fângo a kota gbia ti Tamasese Lealofi III.

en: There are many beaches, due to Auckland's straddling of two harbours. The most popular ones are in three areas.
sg: Gba ti a ndömbütü a yeke da , ngbanga ti chevauchement ti a poro ûse ti Auckland. A so iri a wu a yeke na ya ti gbefâ ota.

en: North Shore beaches (in North Harbour district) are on the Pacific Ocean and stretch from Long Bay in the north to Devonport in the south.
sg: A ndömbütü ti ngûîngö ti banga (na ya ti gbâvaka ti North Harbour) a yeke na ndo ti kötä ngû-hîngö ti wasîrîrî na a gue na mbague ti Long Bay na banga na Devonport na tö.

en: They are almost all sandy beaches with safe swimming, and most have shade provided by pohutukawa trees.
sg: A yeke a ndömbütü kûê pëpe si a mbütü wara sükülängö-ngû a yeke nzönî, mingi a yeke na a gbedê ti a keke ti pohutukawa.

en: Tamaki Drive beaches are on the Waitemata Harbour, in the upmarket suburbs of Mission Bay and St Heliers in Central Auckland.
sg: Ndömbütü ti Tamaki Drive a yeke na pôro ti Waitemata, na ya ti pendere gbata ti Mission Bay na St Heliers na ya ti bê ti Auckland.

en: These are sometimes-crowded family beaches with a good range of shops lining the shore. Swimming is safe.
sg: A yeke a ndömbütü ti a sëwä si âmbênî gba ti a djoni dangêrë a mu terête. Sükülängö-ngû a yeke na kpale pepe.

en: The main local beer is 'Number One', it is not a complex beer, but pleasant and refreshing. The other local beer is called "Manta".
sg: Samba ti kodoro so azo ahinga mingi ayeke"Number One", ayeke senge samba, me anzere nga na asara nzoni na tere ti zo. Mbeni samba ti kodoro ni ayeke "Manta".

en: There are many French wines to be had, but the New Zealand and Australian wines might travel better.
sg: Ayeke na ambeni gbati avin ti falanzi, me avin ti azo ti Néo-Zélande nga ti azo ti Australie a gue gëne mingi.

en: The local tap water is perfectly safe to drink, but bottled water is easy to find if you are fearful.
sg: Ngu ti robinet ti kodoro ayeke nzoni ti yongo ni, me mo yeke wara hio ngu ti gbënda tongana mbeto a sara mo.

en: For Australians, the idea of 'flat white' coffee is foreign. A short black is 'espresso', cappuccino comes heaped high with cream (not froth), and tea is served without milk.
sg: Ti azo ti Australie, tene na ndoti Kâwa"vuru kobe" ayeke ti wande. Kete vokongo ni ayeke "expresso", cappuccino ni asi na creme (asara mousse pepe) nga na dütë mu na azo Dulê a nga dapëe.

en: The hot chocolate is up to Belgian standards. Fruit juices are pricey but excellent.
sg: Chocolat tî wâ aba andia ti abelge.Ngere ti ajus ti lë tî këkë ayeke ngangu me ayeke anzere mingi.

en: Many trips to the reef are made all year around, and injuries due to any of these causes on the reef are rare.
sg: Gbati aguengo gene so a wara mbeni ye ti kpalé asi mingi na ya ti ngu, nga na aKä so alondo ka ayeke kete.

en: Still, take advice from authorities, obey all signs, and pay close attention to safety warnings.
sg: Atâa, ala mu peko ti awängö kota azo ti kodoro, ala mû nëngö na apanneau kue nga na sara hange so ayeke nde

en: Box jellyfish occur near beaches and near river estuaries from October to April north of 1770. They can occasionally be found outside these times.
sg: Abozo ti meduses ayeke na mbage ti mbutu sese ngana akota ngu ti nze ti Ngberere asi nze ti Ngoube na mbage ti banga ti ngu 1770.E pe ti wara ala kue na angoi so afa ge pepe.

en: Sharks do exist, however they rarely attack humans. Most sharks are scared of humans and would swim away.
sg: Arequin ayeke da, me ala sara sioni mingi na zo pepe. Mbe gbati arequin a ayeke na mbëtö ti azo nga na ala kpe na yati ngu.

en: Saltwater Crocodiles do not actively live in the ocean, their primary habitat is in river estuaries north from Rockhampton.
sg: Angoude ti ngu ingo alango lakue lakue na ngu ingo pepe, ndo ti lango ti ala ayeke a estuaire ti angu ti banga ti Rockhampton.

en: Booking in advance gives the traveller peace of mind that they will have somewhere to sleep once they arrive at their destination.
sg: Batango ndo kozo ayeke sara si gene aduti na siriri ti tene loyeke wara ndo ti lango tongana ndo lo ngba ti gue da.

en: Travel agents often have deals with specific hotels, although you may find it possible to book other forms of accommodation, like camping grounds, through a travel agent.
sg: Azo ti kua ti ndokua ti agene ala ayeke lakue lakue na amango tere na pendere ando ti lango, atâa mo pe ti bata mbeni ando ti lango nde, tongana ando ti camping, na ngangu ti zo ti ndokua ti agene.

en: Travel agents usually offer packages that include breakfast, transportation arrangements to/from the airport or even combined flight and hotel packages.
sg: Azo ti kua ti ndokua ti agene ala mu kete ngere so ayeke na kete kode ti ndaperere, mungo kutukutu ti gueno/londo na aéroport wala kete ngere ayeke na gene nga na ndo ti lango.

en: They can also hold the reservation for you if you need time to think about the offer or procure other documents for your destination (e.g. visa).
sg: Ala pe ti bata aye ndali ti mo tongana mo ye ti gbu li ti mo na ndo ni wala wara ambeti nde ndali ti ndo so mo yeke gue da (tapande visa)

en: Any amendments or requests though should be coursed through the travel agent first and not directly with the hotel.
sg: Atâa, biängo wala hunda kue mo du ati toka na azo ti ndokua ti gene nga na hio na ndo ti lango ti mo pepe.

en: For some festivals, the vast majority of the attendants to music festivals decide to camp on site, and most attendants consider it a vital part of the experience.
sg: Ti ambeni amatanga, kota mingi ti azo ti amatanga ti mozoko aye ti lango ka, nga na azo ti amatanga ti mozoko aba yani tongana mbeni ye ti ngangu teti mandango ye.

en: If you want to be close to the action you're going to have to get in early to get a camping site close to the music.
sg: Tongana mo ye ti ga nduru ti sara mbeni ye, ala du ta ti si na ndaperere teti wara ndo ti camping so ayeke nduru na mozoko.

en: Remember that even though music on the main stages may have finished, there may be sections of the festival that will keep playing music until late into the night.
sg: Ala girisa pepe atâa pikango mozoko na ando ti fango ye ahunzi, mbeni ambage ti amatanga so agba ala ke gue ti pika mozoko ti si lakui ahon.

en: Some festivals have special camping areas for families with young children.
sg: Ambeni amatanga asara ni na lege ti camping so ayeke nde teti asewa nga na amaseka.

en: If crossing the Northern Baltic in winter, check the cabin location, as going through ice causes quite horrible noise for those most affected.
sg: Tongana mo fâ lêgë ti Baltique ti Banga na hiver, ala ba nzoni ndo so cabine ayeke da, ndali ti fângo lêgë ti glace ake sara si zo a ma go ti toto na mbage ti azo so be ti alal asön.

en: Saint Petersburg cruises include time in town. Cruise passengers are exempted from visa requirements (check the terms).
sg: Tambula na amagboko na Saint-Pétersbourg amu ngbonga so ala ke sara na ya ti ngbata ni. Azo ti tambula na mangboko ayeke hunda ala visa (ala na nzoni nye la ahunda ala ti sara nî).

en: Casinos typically make many efforts to maximize time and money spent by guests. Windows and clocks are usually absent, and exits can be hard to find.
sg: Acasino asara ngangu mîngi ti mu gbati agbonga nga na mosoro so azo asigi. Afenetere nga na angbonga ayeke da pepe nga na warango lege ti sïgïngo ni ayeke ngangu mingi.

en: They usually have special food, drink and entertainment offers, to keep guests in a good mood, and keep them at the premise.
sg: Ala yeke mu nzoni kobe so ayeke nde, asamba nga na mara ti angia nde nde, ti sara si azo duti nzoni nga na sara si titene ala ngba gi ka.

en: Some venues offer alcoholic beverages on the house. However, drunkenness impairs judgement, and all good gamblers know the importance of staying sober.
sg: Ambeni da ti yongo samba a mu samba so ayeke na alcool na yanga da. Atâa, soulengo na samba abuba iri ti zo nga na a nzoni zo ti ndembo kue ahinga ndali ti yo gi kete samba.

en: Anyone who's going to drive at high latitudes or over mountain passes should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or freezing temperatures.
sg: Zo kue ayeke huru na nduzu ahon mingi wala ambage ti hoto a du a ti za na li ti lo lo yeke wara fukungû, glace wala dedengo température ni.

en: On icy and snowy roadways, friction is low and you cannot drive as if you were on bare asphalt.
sg: Na alege ti de ngana neige, tere ti ala ade mingi pepe nga na ala pe ti yo kutukutu pepe tongana ala yeke na senge asphalte.

en: During blizzards, enough snow to get you stuck can fall in very little time.
sg: Na ngoi ti blizzards, gbati a neige ape ti na ndo ti ala na kete ngbonga.

en: Visibility may also be restricted by falling or blowing snow or by condensation or ice on vehicle windows.
sg: Bango nzoni na le ti ala ape ti kanga ndali ti tingo ti neinge wala fuku wala aye ni akpingba wala a glace so ayeke na avitre ti kututukutu.

en: On the other hand, icy and snowy conditions are normal in many countries, and traffic goes on mostly uninterrupted all year round.
sg: Na mbange nde, a conditions ti verglas wala neige ayeke kpale pepe na ndo ti gbati akodoro nga na tamulango a gue ngbii ti si ngu oko.

en: Safaris are perhaps the greatest tourism draw in Africa and the highlight for many visitors.
sg: Safaris ayeke kota pendere aye agongbi gbati atouriste na Afrika nga na ayeke ndo so agene a ba ti tene ayeke na nduzu mingi ahon.

en: The term safari in popular use refers to overland travel to view the stunning African wildlife, particularly on savanna.
sg: Tene ti safaris na yanga ti lakue lakue afa guengo agene na lege ti sese ndali ti ba pendere anyama ti Afrika, mingi na ndo ti kete apere

en: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, tend to approach closely to cars and standard equipment will allow good viewing.
sg: Mbeni anyama, tongana adoli nga na a girafe, ayeke ga nduru na kutukutu ti ala nga gbakuru so aza da ayeke mu lege na ala ti ba nzoni sî.

en: Lions, cheetahs and leopards are sometimes shy and you will see them better with binoculars.
sg: Abamara, azen so a loro hio nga na a léopard ala ke sara mbeto nga na ala pe ti ba ala gi na jumelles ni.

en: A walking safari (also called a "bush walk", "hiking safari", or going "footing") consists of hiking, either for a few hours or several days.
sg: Guengo na safari na gere (a iri ni kue « tambula na yaka », « safari na gere » wala « gue na gere » ayeke bango ndo na gere so ayeke ninga mbeni angbonga wala gbati alango.

en: The Paralympics will take place from 24 August to 5 September 2021. Some events will be held in other locations throughout Japan.
sg: Angia ti paralympiques ayeke mu ndo londo na lango 24 ti nze ti Koukourou a si lango 5 ti nze ti Mvouka ngu 2021. Ambeni amatanga ayeke mu ndo na ando nde nde ti Japon.

en: Tokyo will be the only Asian city to have hosted two summer Olympics, having hosted the games in 1964.
sg: Tokyo ayeke duti oko gbata ti Asie so agongbi use Angia olympiques ti été , so agongbi angia na ngu 1964

en: If you booked your flights and accommodation for 2020 before the postponement was announced, you may have a tricky situation.
sg: Tongana ala bata aguengo gene ti ala nga na ando ti lango teti ngu 2020 kozo tene ti so mbeni ye ayeke mu ndo na lango wala ngu ti peko, ala yeke wara kota kpalé.

en: Cancellation policies vary, but as of late March most coronavirus-based cancellation policies don't extend to July 2020, when the Olympics had been scheduled.
sg: Aporoso ti za ya ni ayeke nde, me na hunzingo nze ti mbango, aporoso kue ti za ayeni ndali ti coronasvirus ayeke gue ti na nze ti lêngao ngu 2020 pepe, lango so angia ti Olympique amu ndo.

en: It's expected that most event tickets will cost between ¥2,500 and ¥130,000, with typical tickets costing around ¥7,000.
sg: E ye titene a billet ti amatanga kue aduti na popo ti 2500 nga na 130,000, a billet nde ayeke 7000.

en: Ironing damp clothes can help them dry. Many hotels have an iron and ironing board available for loan, even if one is not present in the room.
sg: Pasêngo abongo a ayeke na kete ngu ape ti ôle yani. Gbati ando ti lango mu fer nga na agbakuru ti pasengo ni, atâa ayeke na ndo ti lango ti lo pepe.

en: If an iron isn't available, or if you don't fancy wearing ironed socks, then you can try using a hairdryer, if available.
sg: Tongana fer ayeke da pepe wala ala mo ye ti yo a chaussette so apasêe awe, mo pe ti sara na gbakuru ti ôlengo kwa so ayeke da.

en: Be careful not to allow fabric to become too hot (which can cause shrinkage, or in extreme cases, scorch).
sg: Ala kpe ti za wa na bongo ti ala (ndali ti so apeti ga kete wala, wara agbï biani).

en: There are different ways of purifying water, some more effective against specific threats.
sg: Alege ti wara nzoni ngu ayeke nde, ambeni ayeke ngangu ahon nga na ngangû so ayeke nde.

en: In some areas boiling water for a minute is enough, in others several minutes are needed.
sg: Na ambeni agbakodoro, kporo ngu na ngbonga oko alingbi, na mbêni ye, ayeke ninga angbonga mingi.

en: Filters vary in effectiveness, and should you have a concern, then you should consider buying your water in a sealed bottle from a reputable company.
sg: Ngangu ti a filtre ape ti duti nde nga na tongana ala wara kpalé, ayeke nzoni ala vo gnu ti ala ngbënda akanga biani na ndokua ti vongo ngu ni.

en: Travellers may encounter animal pests that they are not familiar with in their home regions.
sg: Agene ape ti tîngbi tërë na ayati na da ti ala so ala ba lakue lakue pepe na da ti agbakodoro ti ala.

en: Pests can spoil food, cause irritation, or in a worse case cause allergic reactions, spread venom, or transmit infections.
sg: Asënë ape ti buba kobe, sara si aye a sigi na ndo ti poro ti tere ti ala waka, ape ti ga na kpalé, réaction so ayeke allergique, asara sioni wala amu kobela ndali ti microbes.

en: Infectious diseases themselves, or dangerous animals that can injure or kill people by force, do not usually qualify as pests.
sg: Akobela ti infection ala mveni, wala anyama so asara kpale so ape ti kä wala fâ azo na ngangu, amu ala tongana parasites pepe.

en: Duty free shopping is the opportunity to buy goods exempted from taxes and excises at certain locations.
sg: Vongo ye so azi taxe da ayeke lege ti vongo akungba so moyeke futa taxte pepe nga na ti accise na mbeni ndo.

en: Travellers bound for countries with heavy taxation can sometimes save a considerable amount of money, especially on products such as alcoholic beverages and tobacco.
sg: Agene so gue na akodoro so hundango a taxe yake ngangu ala pe ti bata mbeni mosole so ayeke mingi, ndali ti samba ti alcool nga na tabac.

en: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain.
sg: Lege na popo ti Point Marion nga na Fairmont ayeke na mbeni ye ti ngangu ti gue na yani na autoroute ti Buffalo-Pittsburgh, fango lege lakue lakue ti ando so ayeke yongoro na yaka.

en: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.
sg: Tongana mo hinga ti kue na kutukutu na alege ti vaka pepe, ala duti kpo: alege sp ayeke ngangu ti guengo ni, kete alege nga na kete avirage ayeke da.

en: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.
sg: Akangango ti loro so afa da ayeke na gbeni na ala ti alege so afa kozo nga na peko - mingi mph 35-40 (km/h 56-64) - nga nëngö ti lo ayeke ngangu mingi na aye so zo asara kozo.

en: Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
sg: Atâa a ndokua ti singa ti yongo ni ayeke ngangu ahon ge so nga na ndo ti ambeni gbati alege ti guengo ni, tapande kota Yaka ti Pennsylvanie.

en: German pastries are quite good, and in Bavaria, are quite rich and varied, similar to those of their southern neighbor, Austria.
sg: Agateau ti azo ti Zâmani ayeke pendere, nga na Bavière, aza da mbeni ye nde nde, akpa aye so ti amba ti ala ti mbongo, Autriche.

en: Fruit pastries are common, with apples cooked into pastries year round, and cherries and plums making their appearances during the summer.
sg: Agateaux aleke na alë azo asarani mingi, nga na pomme ala za na ndo ti gateaux ngu kue, nga na cerises nga na a prunes so aba gigi na été.

en: Many German baked goods also feature almonds, hazelnuts, and other tree nuts. Popular cakes often pair particularly well with a cup of strong coffee.
sg: Gbati aye ti boulangerie ti Zâmani ayeke na amendes, noisettes nga na mbeni mara ti ndika. A gateaux azo kue ahinga ague mingi legeoko nzoni na kopo ti ngangu kâwa.

en: If you want some small though rich pastries, try what depending on region are called Berliner, Pfannkuchen or Krapfen.
sg: Tongana mo ye akete gateau me aleke pendere, ala tära ye so a iri na gbakodoro ti Berliner, Pfannkuchen wala Krapfen.

en: A curry is a dish based on herbs and spices, together with either meat or vegetables.
sg: Curry ayeke kobe asara na kugbe ti kasa nga na kugbe so azia da na kobe, nga na nyama ti bagara wala Kugbë tî kâsa.

en: A curry can be either "dry" or "wet" depending on the amount of liquid.
sg: Curry ape ti duti wala " a ôle" wala "na ngu" ti ba wungo ti a ngu ayeke na ya nî.

en: In inland regions of Northern India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in curries; in Southern India and some other coastal regions of the subcontinent, coconut milk is commonly used.
sg: Na agbakodoro ti Inde ti Banga nga na ti Pakistan, yaourt asara ni mingi na curry; na mbage ti mbongo ti Inde nga na na ambeni agbakodoro keketi coco tna yani kete ndo, zo asara dulê ti coco mingi.

en: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian food is an umbrella term covering a vast variety of regional cuisines found across the nation.
sg: Na azua 17 000 so azo a pe ti soso, da köbe ti Indonésie ayeke kota tene so agbu mara kobe nde nde ti agbakodoro so e pe ti wara na kodoro kue.

en: But, if used without further qualifiers, the term tends to mean the food originally from the central and eastern parts of the main island Java.
sg: Me, tongana tene ni ayeke senge, aten ayeke fa kobe ti ambage ti bê ti codoro nga na ti tô ti kozo zûa ti Java.

en: Now widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine features an array of simply seasoned dishes, the predominant flavorings the Javanese favor being peanuts, chillies, sugar (especially Javanese coconut sugar) and various aromatic spices.
sg: Londo ti laso ayeke na zua kue, da kobe ti Java au mara ti kobe nde nde so a fu pendere, arome so azo ti zua ti Java aye mingi ayeke akârâkö, adöngö, sukäni (mingi sukäni ti coco ti azo ti Java) nga na ambeni pendere aye ti za da na kobe.

en: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.
sg: A étrier ayeke mbeni ye ti mu ngangu na gere zo so lo gue na ndoti mbârâtâ so a ti na ambage use kue ti ngende so a za da na ndoti mbârâtâ.

en: They provide greater stability for the rider but can have safety concerns due to the potential for a rider's feet to get stuck in them.
sg: Ala yeke ga na kota siriri na azo so a gue na gbâzâbängâ, me ape ti ga na kpale na siriri na aye so ape ti sara si agere ti lo akanga na popo ti bâzâbängâ ni.

en: If a rider is thrown from a horse but has a foot caught in the stirrup, they could be dragged if the horse runs away. To minimize this risk, a number of safety precautions can be taken.
sg: Tongana mbârâtâ abi zo na sese nga na gere ti lo akanga na étrier, mbârâtâ ayeke mu loro na lo biani. Ti kiri mara kpale so kete, azo adu a ti zia na sese mbeni andia ti siriri nî.

en: First, most riders wear riding boots with a heel and a smooth, quite narrow, sole.
sg: Kozo ni, mingi azo ti guengo na mbârâtâ ayo poro so ayeke na talon nga na semelle so akpingba pepe na so ayeke kete.

en: Next, some saddles, particularly English saddles, have safety bars that allow a stirrup leather to fall off the saddle if pulled backwards by a falling rider.
sg: Na peko, mbeni ngende ti dutingo na mbârâtâ, mingi ti azo ti Angelëe, ayeke na keke ti siriri so asara si étrier ati londo na ngende tongana zo ti guneo na mbârâtâ so ati agbu lo na peko.

en: Cochamó Valley - Chile's premier climbing destination, known as the Yosemite of South America, with a variety of granite big walls and crags.
sg: Vallée de Cochamó - Kozo ndo ti kô na ya tî ahoto ti Chili, azo ahinga mingi na iri tiYosemite ti Amerika ti mbongo, nga na amara akota dere nga na tene ayeke na granit.

en: Summits include breath-taking views from peaks. Climbers from all parts of the world are continually establishing new routes amongst its endless potential of walls.
sg: Anduzu ti ahoto afa pendere bango ye so ayeke pendere mingi. Azo ti kôngo na ya tî ahoto ti agbakodoro ti dunia kue afa ambeni fini alege lakue lakue na ndo ti adere ti lo akono mingi.

en: Downhill snowsports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports involving sliding down snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.
sg: A sport ti neige ti tingo, so agongbi ski nga na snowboard, ayeke sport so azo kue ahinga ayeke ti glisser na ndo ti neige na aski wala keke ti neige akanga na gere ti ala.

en: Skiing is a major travelling activity with many enthusiasts, occasionally known as "ski bums," planning entire vacations around skiing at a particular location.
sg: Ski ayeke kusara so asara si zo a ye ti gue gene mingi, a iri ala "azo aye ski mingi", so a aza da guengo ti hu tere sarango gi ski na mbeni ndo so ayeke nde.

en: The idea of skiing is very old — cave paintings depicting skiers date back as far as 5000 BC!
sg: Tene ti ski ayeke ngbere tene ni - angbere mbamba so afa azo ti sky alondo na angu 5000 kozo gango ti Jésus - Christ!

en: Downhill skiing as a sport goes back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.
sg: Ski ti alpin ayeke sport so alondo na ngungbangbo balë ôko na mbâsâmbâlâ na ga, na ngu 1861, kozo kundu ti ski so agongbi azo a ba gigi na azo ti Norvège na kodoro ti Australie.

en: Backpacking by ski: This activity is also called backcountry ski, ski touring or ski hiking.
sg: Tambula na ski:Kusara ni so a iri tambula na ski, ski ti tambula wala tambula na ski.

en: It is related to but usually not involving alpine style ski touring or mountaineering, the latter ones done in steep terrain and requiring much stiffer skis and boots.
sg: Agongbi palaze oko me adu a titene ski ti tambula wala sarango mara alpinisme ti alpin pepe, tangani so asara ni na ndo ti ahoto nga na ahunda a ski nga na aporo so akpengba mingi.

en: Think of the skiing route as of a similar hiking route.
sg: Ala gbu li ti ala na ndo ti lege ti ski nga na lege ti guengo tambula.

en: In good conditions you will be able to cover somewhat greater distances than walking – but only very seldom you will get the speeds of cross country skiing without a heavy backpack in groomed tracks.
sg: Tongana ndo ayeke nzoni, ala pe ti gue ndo so ayo mingi ahon senge tambula, me ala yeke na loro ti ski pepe tongana bozo ti alal ti peko a nëin pepe na lege so ayeke ngangu.

en: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
sg: Poto ayeke continent so ayeke kete me ayeke na gbati akodoro so ayeke ayamba.Na nzoni ngoi, guengo gene na gbati akodoro atene mo yeke hunda ti wara visa fâni mingi nga bango i mbeti ti passeport.

en: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.
sg: Ndo ti Schengen, atâa so, asara tongana gi kodoro oko na yati ndani so.

en: As long as you stay in this zone, you can generally cross borders without going through passport control checkpoints again.
sg: Tongana ala ngba gi na ndo ni so, ala ke fa yanga ti kodoro akanbgi na kodoro nde na ando so ape ti ba a passeport ti ala pepe.

en: Similarly, by having a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for visas to each of the Schengen member countries separately, hence saving time, money and paperwork.
sg: Atâa tongana ala yeke na visa Schengen ala pe ti hunda a visa ti kodoro oko oko ti akodoro ti schengen pepe, ala ke bata ngbonga, nginza nga na gbati mbeti.

en: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.
sg: Fango tene so dunia kue ahinga ayeke da pepe ti akungba so alondo na mbeni ndokua ti kusala a iri ala akungba ti antiquité. Mbeni azo ti impot afa akungba ahon angu 100 tongana ti akungba ti antiquité.

en: The definition has geographic variations, where the age limit might be shorter in places such as North America than in Europe.
sg: Tene ti variation géographique wala kiri ngu kete ape ti duti kete ahon na ando tongana Amerika ti Banga nga na Poto.

en: Handicraft products might be defined as antiques, though they are younger than similar mass-produced goods.
sg: Akungba zo aleke na maboko ape ti ga tongana angbere ye ni, atâa ayeke maseka ahon akungba so akpa lo ala leke lege na lege oko.

en: Reindeer husbandry is an important livelihood among the Sámi and the culture surrounding the trade is important also for many with other professions.
sg: Batango arenne ayeke ngangu lege ti duti na fini na Samis nga na mara ye nde nde aba debuze ayeke ngangu kue ti akpengbango azo.

en: Even traditionally, though, not all Sámi have been involved in big scale reindeer husbandry, but lived from fishing, hunting and similar, having reindeer mostly as draft animals.
sg: Atâa, bango asarango ye ti akotara a Samis agongbi ala na kota batango ti a renne pepe, fângo anyama nga na mbeni ye, ayeke na renne tongana anyama so amu na ala dulë.

en: Today many Sámi work in modern trades. Tourism is an important income in Sápmi, the Sámi area.
sg: Laso, gbati Sami a sara kua na afini kusara ti maboko.Tourisme ayeke ngangu lege ti warango nginza na Sápmi, gbakodoro ti sami.

en: Though it is widely used, especially among non-Romani, the word "Gypsy" is often considered offensive because of its associations with negative stereotypes and inaccurate perceptions of Romani people.
sg: Atâa asara na yani mingi pepe, mingi na popo ti azo so ayeke Romans pepe, tene ti "Tsigane" aueke tene atene mbeni sioni ye ndali ti agongbi ti stéréotype so ayeke nzoni pepe nga na bango aye ti sioni ti azo ti Roman.

en: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected.
sg: Tongana mbeti ti guengo gene ti kodoro so mo gue da, mbeti ti batango tere ti mo ti guengo gene wala mbeti ti bi batango tere ti mo apeti wara kpalé.

en: You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens.
sg: Ala pe ti ba wango ti agovoroma senge ahon ti ala, me awango azia yani na sese ndali ti azo ti kodoro ti ala.

en: As one example, American citizens in the Middle East might face different situations from Europeans or Arabs.
sg: Tapande, azo ti Amerika na Moyen-Orient ape ti wara mbeni kpalé ayeke nde nga na ala so ti azo ti Poto wala ti Arabe.

en: Advisories are merely a brief summary of the political situation in one country.
sg: Mbeti ti sarango ânge ayeke gi nduru tene ti mbeni aye ti poroso ti kodoro ni.

en: The views presented are often cursory, general and oversimplified compared to the more detailed information available elsewhere.
sg: Atene so azo a mu ni ayeke gi na ngangu kete, aba aye nde nde nga na ayeke senge na bango asango so afa aye mingi mbe ndo.

en: Severe weather is the generic term for any dangerous weather phenomenon with the potential to cause damage, serious social disruption, or loss of human life.
sg: Sioni sêndo ayeke tene ti fa aye so kue ti sêndo aga na kpalé ape ti buba aye kue, sioni a kpalé ti azo wala bubango agigi ti azo.

en: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the world, and there are different types of it, which can depend on geography, topography, and atmospheric conditions.
sg: Sioni sêndo ape ti ba gigi na ndo kue na yati dunia so, nga na ayeke amara nde nde, so ape ti londo na mara ndo ti sese, ti topographie nga na ti a asango ti sêndo nî.

en: High winds, hail, excessive precipitation, and wildfires are forms and effects of severe weather, as are thunderstorms, tornadoes, waterspouts, and cyclones.
sg: Sioni sêndo, ngandângombe, angangu ngu nzapa ahondoni nga na gbingo ti yaka mara nga na aye so afa asioni sêndo, nga na apïrïwä, abëkpä, trombe ti ngu nga na akota ngangu pupu.

en: Regional and seasonal severe weather phenomena include blizzards, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.
sg: Asigingo ti aye ti asioni sêndo ti agbakodoro nga na angoi nde nde agongbi ablizzar, apïrïwä ti neige, apïrïwä ti kandângû nga na apïrïwä ti mburuse.

en: Travellers are strongly advised to be aware of any risk of severe weather affecting their area as they may affect any travel plans.
sg: Amu wango na agene ala hinga nzoni si kpale so kue ape ti si ndali ti sioni sêndo ape ti ga na gbakodoro ti ala, ayekebi na sese pialö ti guengo gene ti ala.

en: Anyone planning a visit to a country that could be considered a war zone should get professional training.
sg: Zo so aye ti gue na kodoro so ayeke na ndo ti tiringo bira lo du a ti wara mbeni kpengbango mandango ye ni

en: A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company.
sg: Gingo ye na internet ti "mandango ye nde nde so angoro azo so ayeke sioni" ayeke fa mbeni ndo ti ndokua ti kusara ti kodoro oko.

en: A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience.
sg: Mandango ye oko ayeke gongbi ahunda kue e ba ge na lege ti aye ni kue, ahon kue na yati hingango ye so asara na ni lakue lakue.

en: A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training.
sg: A mandango ye oko ayeke ninga teti so azo ahinga londo alango 2 tii 5 nga na agongbi angia ti agbungo li ti mbeni ye, mingi ti akozo mungo maboko nga na mandango ti angombe.

en: Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.
sg: Agbuku nga na ambëtïsango afa dutingo na popo ti anyama so alango na gigi ayeke da mingi, me agbuku afa ando so azo atiri bira ayeke a mingi pepe.

en: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.
sg: Agene aye ti wara opération ti bïängbï ti dutingo ti koli wala ti wali ti ala na nodoro wande ala hinga nzoni biani si ala yo ambeti alingbi dali ti guengo gene ti kiringi ti ala na kodoro.

en: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
sg: Bibe ti govoroma ti mu a passeport na ya ni dutingo ti koli wala ti wali ayeke da pepe (x) wala ambeti azo a za da fini asango lakue lakue ti fa iri nga na ti koli wala ti wali ape ti duti nde.

en: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
sg: Bibe ti govoroma ti wande ti mû nëngö na yati ambeti ni so ayeke nde kue.

en: Searches at security checkpoints have also become far more intrusive in the post-September 11, 2001 era.
sg: Akusala ti gingo gingo mbeni ye na aturugu na ndokua ti kusala na gbe bembengo ndo ti siriri aga mingi londo lango ti 11 nze ti mvouka ngu 2001.

en: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
sg: Azo so aga koli wala wali na peko ti opération ni ala pe ti zia ala na ndoti scanner pepe nga na gigi ti ala so zo ape ti hinga pepe nga na nengo ti la ayeke bian pepe.

en: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar.
sg: Ngangu ti ngu so akiri ayeke kota ngu so afa na ndo ti mbutu sese, mingi na mbage ti récif wala so ague legeoko.

en: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.
sg: Ndali ti topologie ti gbe ti ngu, gbati aye akiri agongbi na yati ambage so ayeke na gbeni ahon, nga na gango ti a gbati ngu hio ti gue na mbage so ngu ayeke na gbeni mingi ahon.

en: Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible.
sg: Akua mingi a si ndali ti kara ti tara ti fa ngu na maboko na ndo so gbati ngu aga na ngangu, so zo ape ti sara pepe.

en: As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally.
sg: Tongana ala londo na ndo so ngu asara ngangu mingi, fango na maboko ayeke ga ngangu nga na kozo.

en: Try aiming somewhere where you are not caught again or, depending on your skills and on whether you have been noticed, you might want to wait for rescue.
sg: Tära ti gue ndo so ape ti gbu ala pepe fani use wala, ndali ti andara ti alal nga na tongana mbeni zo aba ala, ala ye ti ku mbeni zo a ga ti mu maboko na ala.

en: Re-entry shock comes on sooner than culture shock (there's less of a honeymoon phase), lasts longer, and can be more severe.
sg: Pasi ti kiringo na kodoro ayeke ga kozo pasi ti dutingo na azo (kete nzerengo warango tere ti wali na ti koli), ayeke ninga mingi na a pe ti ga ngangu mingi.

en: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture.
sg: Awaguengo-guengo ala so si ayeke na tango ti mandango fini dutingo ti kodoro nde a wara pkale ti kiri na dutingo ti kodoro ti ala mveni.

en: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.
sg: Tongana mo kiri na kodoro na peko ti dutingo na kodoro ti wande, mo yeke manda fini dutingo ti azo nga na mo ke grisa ambeni dutingo ti kodoro ti mo.

en: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.
sg: Tongana mo gue na kodoro ti wande kozo, mo yeke ba azo so a duti kpo nga na a ma mo nzoni, ala hinga tongana awaguengo-guengo ala si na yati fini kodoro ala ke manda fini dutingo ni.

en: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.
sg: Azo ala pe ti ba na dawa pepe ti tene dutingo kpo nga na mandango ye ayeke ngangu na awaguengo-guengo ala so ayeti ti kiri na ndo ti ala.

en: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.
sg: Fango go nga na la ti pyramide ayeke oko aye so ayeke pendere na agbakodoro ti amolenge.

en: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.
