sg: Mo pe ti ba apyramide so na bi nga na na ngoi so si ndo ni aduti kpo kozo amatanga atondani.

en: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.
sg: Lakue mo yeke ma a go ti a touriste na azo ti kangoye. Mbai ti woulouwoulou nga na ti wa ayeke tongana gboudou ti mbai.

en: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.
sg: Sphinx a sara teti gbanda ti gbeni nga na wasarango mbeni yongoro mbai.

en: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
sg: A limo so a fa na ndo apyramide na a mbeni apyramide ndende so a su.

en: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have the most bases, with sixteen active in 2020.
sg: A zua ti Shetland ti bongo, a ba gigi na 1819, gba ti a kodoro a ke na a diko ni gbani na gbe ni, na a kusala bale oko na omana na 2020.

en: The archipelago lies 120 km north of the Peninsula. The largest is King George Island with the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.
sg: Archipel a yeke na kilometre 120 na banga ti péninsule. Kuta ni a yeke Île ti gbia George na kodoro ti Villa Las Estrellas.

en: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception where the flooded caldera of a still-active volcano provides a spectacular natural harbour.
sg: Na ya ti ambeni ayeke Île Livingston na Deception, so mbeni volcan a mene caldeira a bungbi si a ga port so a kpa ye ti nzima.

en: Ellsworth Land is the region south of the Peninsula, bounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.
sg: Ellsworkth Land a yeke kodoro ti mbague ti bongo ti péninsule, a kangbi popo ni na ngu ingo ti Bellingshausen.

en: The mountains of the Peninsula here merge into the plateau, then re-emerge to form the 360 km chain of the Ellsworth Mountains, bisected by the Minnesota Glacier.
sg: Ahoto ti péninsule a bungbi gue na ya ti kete hoto, nga a kiri aga ti du a kuta gbako ti km 360 ti hoto Ellsworth, ya ni afa usse na glacier ti Minnesota.

en: The northern part or Sentinel Range has Antarctica's highest mountains, the Vinson Massif, peaking at 4892 m Mount Vinson.
sg: Mbage ti banga wala Sentinel Range ayeke na kota hoto ti Antarctique, Vinson Massif, a lingbi brassi 4892 metre ti Hoto ti Vinson.

en: In remote locations, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.
sg: Na agbata so a yo mingi, ndo so iringo ti singa ayeke da pepe, singa ti satellite a pe ti duti gi lege oko mo pe ti soro ni.

en: A satellite phone is not generally a replacement for a mobile phone, as you have to be outdoors with clear line of sight to the satellite to make a phone call.
sg: Singa ti satellite a pe mu palaze ti singa so mo sara na ni pepe, ndali ti so si mo du a ti ngba na ndo ti gigi so a baa a le na le ti satellite so ayeke mu lege na mo ti iri ndo.

en: The service is frequently used by shipping, including pleasure craft, as well as expeditions who have remote data and voice needs.
sg: Ndokua ti mangboko a sara lakue lakue na ndo ti satellite, nga na amangboko ti sarango ngia kue, nga na ti guengo gene so ahunda asango nga na ago na lege ti internet.

en: Your local telephone service provider should be able to give more information about connecting to this service.
sg: Da ti singa ti kodoro ti ala a du a ti mu a gbai asango na ndo ti connexion ti satellite ni.

en: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
sg: Lege oko so ahon alege kue nga na azo a hinga mingi ndali ti azo aleke ti gue gene na nze ti Pâques ayeke ti gue gene nga na ti manda ye.

en: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
sg: Amaseka so ake za dambeti ala hinga mingi aye, ayeke mu lege na ala ti wara hio kota dambeti, na lege ti buba mandango mbeti ti ala pepe.

en: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
sg: Azo mingi ala za iri ti ala na ngu oko ti paques na kodoro wande a pe ti mai guengo ti hunzi mandango mbeti ti ala na kota dambeti na kodoro ti mo.

en: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
sg: Ahon ye kue, ayeke na mosoro ti dambeti so mo yeke futa ndali ti za iri ti mo na akusala ti mandango mbeti.

en: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.
sg: Kodro séssé ti Finlande a yeke pendere ndo ti süängö. <<Kodro ti a ngûlëndë saki oko>> lo yeke nga na zûâ saki na ndo ni, na ya ti a ngûlëndë na ya ti a archipels yângâ tî ngu.

en: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.
sg: Na ya ti â joa na a ngûlëndë, ala yéké na nzara ti wara gî yatch pèpè.

en: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.
sg: Kameme si a joa ti yanga ti ngu na a kota ngûlëndë a yeke biani kota tene ti a yacht kue, a kette mangbôkô wara a kayak a mu taratï nde.

en: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.
sg: Süängö tinzërëngö-terê a yeke mbeni passe-temps ti kodoro na kodro séssé ti Finlande, na mangbôkô ti a zo mbârâmbârâ wara miambe.

en: This is matched by Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but otherwise quite unique (e.g. in the Netherlands the figure is one to forty).
sg: Yesso a ga oko na Norvège, na Suède na Nouvelle-Zélande, na nga a yeke ye oko(tapande, na Pays-Bas, nzoroko ni a yeke balë-osïö).

en: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
sg: Mingi amangboko so a gue na ndo ti ngu ti baltes so ayeke nde, ayeke mu lege ti lango aninga na Saint-Pétersbourg, na kodoro ti Russie.

en: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
sg: So atene ala pe ti baa ngbere gbata na so ti mbeni alango kue na lege ti kiringo nga na lango na mangboko ti lakui.

en: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
sg: Tongana mo ga gi na lege ti gingo ti bango ndo na yati mangboko, mo yeke gi lege ti wara visa so ayeke nde pepe (londo na 2009).

en: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.
sg: Ambeni guengo na yati mangboko ayeke na Berlin, na Zamani, mo ye baa yani na ambeti. Andaa ala pe ti baa yani na ndo ti a carte so ayeke na nduzu, Berlin a yo mingi na a ngû îngö nga na guengo ti baa gbata a za da yani na ngere ti guengo na yati mangboko pepe.

en: Travelling by plane can be a scary experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, particularly if they've not flown before or have experienced a traumatic event.
sg: Guengo gene na lapara a pe ti duti bango a fini ye a sara mbeto na tere ti azo ti angu kue nga na ahorizon kue, mingi tongana ade ala mu lapara pepe kozo wala tongana ala baa ayeni so asara ala mbeto.

en: It is not something to be ashamed of: it is no different from the personal fears and dislikes of other things that very many people have.
sg: Mo pe ti sara kamënën na ndoni pepe: ayeni so ayeke nde na a mara mbeto ti azo pepe nga na kpale so gbati azo a wara na ndo ti a mbeni ye nde nde.

en: For some, understanding something about how aircraft work and what happens during a flight may help to overcome a fear which is based on the unknown or on not being in control.
sg: Na le ti mbeni azo, hingango mbeni ye ndali ti tambelango ti alapara nga na ye so a gue na tango ti guengo gene na lapara a pe ti mu ngangu zi mbeto so a londo na aye so mo hinga pepe wala ndali ti warango bembengo ndo ti ala mveni pepe.

en: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair.
sg: Andokua ti kusala ti tokango mbeti a futa ala nzoni ndali ti yongo a kungba hio.Ayeke ngangu mingi ti sara kua na peko ti a ngbonga tongana mo sara kua na ambeti ti debuzen akungba wa na ndoti a tango na mbeni ye ti sanzengo ye ndali ti lekengo mbeni ye hio.

en: On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem.
sg: Gueno na mbeni alege, kota andokua ti kusala ala yeke na alapara ti ala mveni, me na ye so a baa alege nde nga na kete andokua ti kusala, a wara kpale.

en: If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs.
sg: Tongana ala toka akungba na lege ti lapara, tongana ye ni ague na kutukutu, a du a ti mu gbati alango ti si na ndo ti zango akungba nga na ndokua ti kiri.

en: The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.
sg: Lege oko so kungba a pe ti gue hio ayeke lege ti tokango kungba, legeoko tongana kungba so mu iri ti lo. Ambela ti andokua ti kusala ti lapara ayeke mu ala lege pepe ti tonka akungba so ayeke na azo ti guengo gene pepe, ala ke li na ngoi ni so.

en: The obvious way of flying in first or business class is to fork out a thick wad of money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to do it for you).
sg: Nzoni lege ti guengo na lapara ti dutingo na mbage ti azo ti kete nginza wala na mbage ti azo ti bgati nzinga ake hunda mo ti fa na le ti zo ti tene mo yeke na nginza (wala, tongana mo hinga mo tene na ndokua ti kusara ti mo lo futa ndali ti mo)

en: However, this does not come cheap: as rough rules of thumb, you can expect to pay up to four times the normal economy fare for business, and eleven times for first class!
sg: Kandaa, ngere ayeke na sese pepe : Tongana e ba ndia so si zo ahinga, ala pe ti futa nginza ahon lege osio ngere ti ngende ti zo ti kete nginza ti azo ti bouze, nga na lege bale oko na oko ti ngende ti zo ti gbati nginza.

en: Generally speaking, there is no point in even looking for discounts for business or first-class seats on direct flights from A to B.
sg: Tongana e ba nzoni, mo pe ti gi mbeni ti zia da ngere na sese pepe ndali ti gingon kozo angende wala ngende ti azo ti kete nginza na aguengo na yati lapara londo na mbage A ti guengo na mbage B.

en: Airlines know well that there is a certain core group of flyers who are willing to pay top dollar for the privilege of getting somewhere fast and in comfort, and charge accordingly.
sg: Ada ti lapara ahinga nzoni ayeke na kundu ti waguengo-guengo so alingbi tere ti futa ngere ayeke ngangu ndali ti si hio na mbeni ndo na nzoni lege, nga na ala hunda gbati nginza.

en: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used.
sg: Li kodoro ti Moldavie ayeke Chisinau. Yanga ti kodoro ayeke roumain, me azo atene yanga ti russe mingi.

en: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict.
sg: Moldavie ayeke kodoro so ayeke na gbati akundu ti azo so a itiri bira na popo ti ala mingi.

en: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country.
sg: Na yati ngu 1994, tiringo bira so a zia da na kodoro ses ti Transnistrie a mu iri ti lo-mveni na mbage ti tô ti Moldavie, so ayeke na govenema ti lo nga na nginza ti lo mveni me akodoro kue so ayeke na ONU a hinga lo pepe.

en: Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations.
sg: Azia da na sese asongo ti akelemba na popo ti akundu use ti Moldavie ataa gingo mango tere ti politique a gue na lege ni pepe.

en: The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.
sg: Kundu ti sambela nzapa so si azo ahinga mingi ayeke a chrétien ti orthodoxe

en: İzmir is the third largest city in Turkey with a population of around 3.7 million, the second biggest port after Istanbul, and a very good transport hub.
sg: Izmir ayeke use kota gbata ti Turquie nga na wungo ti ngüdango 3,7 ti azo, use kota ndo ti ngu ti mangboko na peko ti Istanbul nga na kota ndo ti yo akungba.

en: Once the ancient city of Smyrna, it is now a modern, developed, and busy commercial center, set around a huge bay and surrounded by mountains.
sg: Giriri ngbere gbata ti Smyrne, a ga fadeso kota ndo ti de buze, a mai nga na azo ague ka gbani, ayeke na popo ti a kota gbe ti ngu nga na ahoto a gia yani.

en: The broad boulevards, glass-fronted buildings and modern shopping centers are dotted with traditional red-tiled roofs, the 18th century market, and old mosques and churches, although the city has an atmosphere more of Mediterranean Europe than traditional Turkey.
sg: Kota alege, kota da so ayeke na afenêtere nga na kota ando ti mosoro ti laso ayeke na li ti da ti bansenzi ti bengbä tuiles, ti gara ti ngûngbangbo 18 nga na ngbêne amosquées nga na ada ti nzapa, ataa gbata ni ayeke na gigi so aye mingi ti poto na so ayeke ti basenzi ti méditerranée.

en: The village of Haldarsvík offer views of the nearby island Eysturoy and has an unusual octagonal church.
sg: A gbata ti Haldarsvik a mu bango le ita gbata ti Eysturoy nga na ayeke na da ti nzapa ayeke na ambage miambe so azo a baa mingi pepe.

en: In the churchyard, there are interesting marble sculptures of doves over some tombs.
sg: Na ndo ti lungo kûâ, ayeke na pendere azo ti keke wa so ala leke na yati marbre ti ambipa na ndo ti mbeni ando ti lungo kûâ.

en: It's worth half an hour to stroll about the intriguing village.
sg: Alingbi ndambo a ngbonga ti gue ti tambula na gbata

en: To the north and within easy reach is the romantic and fascinating town of Sintra and which was made famous to foreigners after a glowing account of its splendours recorded by Lord Byron.
sg: Na mbage ti banga nga na nduru ni ayeke gbata ti mungo koli wala wali nga na pendere ti Sintra nga na azo a hinga mingi ndali ti azo ti wande na peko ti a nzoni mbai ti pendere ndo ti lo Lord Byron a fa ni.

en: Scotturb Bus 403 travels regularly to Sintra, stopping at Cabo da Roca.
sg: A kutukutu ti Scottub 403 ague lakue lakue na Sintra, ayeke luti na Cabo da Roca

en: Also to the north visit the great Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima (Shrine), a place of worldwide famous Marian apparitions.
sg: Gi na mbage ti Banga ka, ala gue ti baa kota ndo ti lungo kûâ ti Notre-Dame de Fatima (ndo ti lungo kûâ), ndo so si Marie à ga faa tere ti lo mingi.

en: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population.
sg: Mo grisa pepe ti titene mo ye ti baa ndo so si alu gbati azo ka, nga na ndo so atene gbati ye ndali ti mben azo ti dunia so ayeke ngangu.

en: There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike.
sg: Ayeke na gbati akoli nga na awali angba na gigi dutingo ge, nga na gbati mbeni ye a fa a ita tiala so ala ye mingi wala ita ti ala asara kua tii kuingo ti ala ka, azwif na ala so ayeke azwif pepe.

en: Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.
sg: E hunda na ala, ala baa ndo na yati nengo tere kue, kota ye kue nga na kpengo amba so alingbi na hingango ndo. Ala sara ngia pepe na ndo ti Holocauste wala anazis.

en: Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.
sg: Ala buba ndo na yati sukungo ye wala sungo a graffitis na yati derê ti ada pepe.

en: Barcelona's official languages are Catalan and Spanish. About a half prefer to speak Catalan, a vast majority understands it, and virtually everyone knows Spanish.
sg: Yanga ti kodoro ti Barcelone ayeke Catalan nga na Espagnol. Ndambo azo aye tene gi yanga ti ctalan, mingi na popo ti ala a ma yanga ni nga na azo kue atene espagnol.

en: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.
sg: A hon kue, mingi a tene ti yanga ti kodoro asara ni na Catalan ndali ti so andia atene ayeke kozo yanga ti kodoro so azo kue a du a ti tene.

en: Yet, Spanish is also widely used in public transport and other facilities.
sg: Ataa, azo atene espagnol kue na akutukutu nga na tangani ando kue.

en: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.
sg: Mingi asango kue na yati metro ala za ni na yanga ti catalan, me aye kue ti sioni ayeke si atene na a dafonon ti masini na a gbati tangani ayanga, a mu espagnol, anglais, falazi, arabe nga na japonais.

en: Parisians have a reputation for being egocentric, rude and arrogant.
sg: Azo ti Paris a hinga ala ti du ti azo so ala yeke kabula pepe, ala tene kota atene nga ala ye ti hon azo kue.

en: While this is often only an inaccurate stereotype, the best way to get along in Paris still is to be on your best behavior, acting like someone who is "bien élevé" (well brought up). It will make getting about considerably easier.
sg: Ataa ayeke dutingo na azo so ayeke na lege ni pepe, nzoni mango tere na gbata ti Paris ayeke gi fango nzoni dutingo ti mo, ti fa mo kpa azo so "a bata mo nzoni si". So ayeke zi lege na mo ti guengo na ndo nde.

en: Parisians' abrupt exteriors will rapidly evaporate if you display some basic courtesies.
sg: Ye so ayeke na be ti azo ti Paris a sigi na le ti azo kue hio tongana mo fa na ala nzoni lege ti barango azo.

en: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation.
sg: Parc i kodoro ti akota ngu ti Plitvice ayeke na akeke wa mingi, mara keke ti hêtre, épicéas nga na sapin, na a faa pêrë so alë mîngi ti alpe nga na ti météranée.

en: It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude.
sg: Ayeke na kota gbati a mara ti akundu ti pêrë, ndali ti gbati mara ti kete climats, asese nde nga na ayeke yongoro na niveau nde nde.

en: The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species.
sg: Ndo ni ayeke na kota a mara ti anyama nde nga na andeke.

en: Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species
sg: E baa ka anyama so azo a baa mingi pepe ataa bengbä ours ti poto, nyama a kpa mbo, ngoalö, soukoulou, lynx, gnyaou ti gbako nga na kota a tétras na bgati mbeni anyama so ayeke duti na ala.

en: While visiting the monasteries, women are required to wear skirts covering the knees and have their shoulders covered, too.
sg: Na tango ti guengo ti baa ada nzampa ti amoine, awali a du a yo akûndû ayeke kanga lege ti ala nga na apâmbotï ti ala.

en: Most of the monasteries do provide wraps for women who come unprepared, but if you bring your own, especially one with bright colors, you'll get a smile from the monk or nun at the entrance.
sg: Mingi ada nzampa ti amoine ala ke faa abongo ti wali so ala leke pepe, me tongana mo ga na ti mo, so ayeke na pendere nzoroko, a moine wala wali ti moine ayeke ngia na mo na yanga ti da ti ala.

en: Along the same line, men are required to wear trousers covering the knees.
sg: Na yati atene a gue lege oko, akoli kue a du a ti yo a patalöon so a kanga alïkunï ti ala.

en: This too can be borrowed from the stock at the entrance but that clothing isn't washed after every user so you may not feel comfortable wearing these skirts. One size fits all for men!
sg: Ala pe ti mu bongo na da ti batango akungba so ayeke na yanga ti da, me abongo so ala sukura pepe na peko ti yongo ni lakue lakue, ni la ala pe ti du ti nzoni pepe tonga ala yo akûndû so. Gi yongoro oko ti akoli.

en: Majorcan cuisine, like that of similar zones in the Mediterranean, is based on bread, vegetables and meat (specially pork), and uses olive oil throughout.
sg: Tongo ye ti majorquine, nga na ti ando ti Méditerranée so a kpa tere, a sara ni na mapa, akarakânzi nga na a nyama (mingi ti ngourou) nga na ala sara na mafuta ti olive na ndo kue.

en: A simple popular dinner, especially during the summer, is the Pa amb Oli: Bread with olive oil, tomato, and any available condiments such as cheese, tunafish, etc.
sg: Tengo kobe ti lakui azo a hinga, mingi na ngoi ti été, ayeke Pa amb Oli : mapa so ala sara na mafuta ti olive, na a tomate nga na ye kue akpa fromage, susu ti thon, na mbeni ye nde nde.

en: All nouns, alongside the word Sie for you, always begin with a capital letter, even in the middle of a sentence.
sg: A ere kue, nduru na tene ti Sie ti mo, atondani na kota tene lakue lakue, atâa na bê ti atene.

en: This is an important way to distinguish between some verbs and objects.
sg: Ayeke ngangu lege ti baa na popo ti a tene nga na azo ayeke nde.

en: It also arguably makes reading easier, though writing is somewhat complicated by the need to find out whether a verb or adjective is used in a substantivized form.
sg: Ayeke mu lege ti diko nzoni, atâa sungo mbeti ayeke kete ngangu ndali ti hingango tongana a ten wala adjectif a sara ni na lege ti mara ti substantif.

en: Pronunciation is relatively easy in Italian since most words are pronounced exactly how they are written
sg: Lege ti sarango tene ayeke ngangu pepe na yanga ti Italie ndali ti atene mingi azo atene na lege so si ala ke su ala.

en: The main letters to watch out for are c and g, since their pronunciation varies based on the following vowel.
sg: Atene so ala pe ti baa nzoni si ayeke c nga na g, ndali ti sarango tene ti ala a pe ti sanze ndali ti kete tene so ayeke ga na peko.

en: Also, make sure to pronounce r and rr differently: caro means dear, whereas carro means chariot.
sg: Ala hinga nzoni ti tene r nga na rr na lege nde: caro atene ngere ayeke ngangu, andâa carro atene char.

en: Persian has a relatively easy and mostly regular grammar.
sg: Yanga ti persan ayeke na hingango lege ti sungo ye ayeke ngangu pepe nga na azo ahinga mingi.

en: Therefore, reading this grammar primer would help you learn much about Persian grammar and understand phrases better.
sg: Tongaso, dikongo mbeti ti hingango lege ti sungo ye ayeke zi lege na ala ti manda gbati ye na yanga ti persan nga na ma nzoni atene ti yanga ni.

en: Needless to say, if you know a Romance language, it will be easier for you to learn Portuguese.
sg: Ala pe ti tene pepe, tongana ala hinga yanga ti Rome ala ke hinga hio yanga ti azo ti Portugal.

en: However, people who know a little Spanish may hastily conclude that Portuguese is close enough that it need not be studied separately.
sg: Kamême, azo so a hinga espagnol kete a pe ti tene hio yanga ti Portugal ayeke nduru mingi na yanga ti espagno na zo a du a ti manda yani na lege nde pepe.

en: Pre-modern observatories are usually obsolete today, and remain as museums, or sites of education.
sg: Akundu ti azo ti gingo gingo so ayeke ti laso pepe azo a sara na ndo ni mingi pepe laso nga na ayeke ngba gi musée wala ando ti mandango ye.

en: As light pollution in their heyday was not the kind of problem it is today, they are usually located in cities or at campuses, easier to reach than those built in modern times.
sg: Tongana e yeke baa la so a sigi na nduzu na bi a mu kpale so azo ayeke wara laso pepe, ayeke mingi na kota agbata wala na ya ti ada ti wamandango mbeti, ala pe ti baa ni senge ahon ye so e yeke ba na ngoi ti laso.

en: Most modern research telescopes are enormous facilities in remote areas with favorable atmospheric conditions.
sg: Mingi a telescope ti gingo gingo ti laso ayeke kota ndokua ti kusara na agbata so ayo ba dutingo ti atmosphere so ayeke nzoni.

en: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century.
sg: Bango a keke ti cerise ti fleurs, e hinga iri ti lo hanani, ayeke hingango ti azo ti Japon londo ngûngbangbo 8.

en: The concept came from China where plum blossoms were the flower of choice.
sg: Tene ni a longo na Chine ka fleurs ti prunier ayeke fleur so si azo a ye mingi.

en: In Japan, the first cherry blossom parties were hosted by the emperor only for himself and other members of the aristocracy around the Imperial Court.
sg: Na kodoro ti Japon, kozo Matanga ti keke ti cerise ti fleur a baa gigi na le ti kotazo ti kodoro ndali ti lo-mveni nga na ita ti gbia so alango na ndo ti gbia.

en: Plants look their best when in a natural environment, so resist the temptation to remove even "just one" specimen.
sg: Akoko ayeke pendere na gigi, ala bata tere ti ala ti zi atâa mara ti koko "oko".

en: If visiting a formally arranged garden, collecting "specimens" is also going to get you ejected, without discussion.
sg: Tongana mo gue ti baa yaka so ayeke pendere, ala ke ke ti mu na ala lege ti warango "akoko", mo yeke zi nga yanga pepe.

en: Singapore is generally an extremely safe place to be and very easy to navigate, and you can buy almost anything after arriving.
sg: Singapour ndo so ayeke na siriri na ti gue ka ayeke ngangu pepe, nga na mo pe ti vo aye kue tongana mo si ka.

en: But being placed in the "high tropics" just a few degrees north of equator you will need to deal with both heat (always) and strong sun (when the sky is clear, more rarely).
sg: Me dutingo na "ndo la ayeke su ngangu" na keke adegré na Banga ti equateur, ndowa ayeke sara mo (lakue lakue) nga na ngangu la (na tango so si nduzu a vuru, mingi pepe)

en: There are also a few buses going north to Hebron, the traditional burial place of the Biblical patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and their wives.
sg: mbeni kâra ayeke da a ti guengo na banga ti si na Hébron, ndo ti lungo kua ti basënzi ti kozo Kota azo ti Mbeti ti Nzapa Abraham, Isaac, Jacob nga na awali ti ala.

en: Check that the bus you are thinking of taking goes into Hebron and not just to the nearby Jewish settlement of Kiryat Arba.
sg: Ala ba nzoni si kâra so ala ye ti mu ni a gue na Hébron nga na gi na colonie ti juif ti a voisin ti Kiryat Arba.

en: Inland waterways can be a good theme to base a holiday around.
sg: Alege ti ngu ti kodoro a pe ti duti pendere ndo ti gue ti hu tere ka.

en: For example visiting castles in the Loire Valley, the Rhine valley or taking a cruise to interesting cites on the Danube or boating along the Erie Canal.
sg: Täpandë, gue ti baa achateau na ndo ti pere ti Loire, ndo ti pere ti Rhin wala gue na mangboko na pendere agbata ti Danube wala na lege ti canal ti Erié.

en: They also define routes for popular hiking and cycling trails.
sg: ala za da na sese alege ti gue tambela nga na lege ti azo kue so si agbâzâbängâ ayeke tambela na yani.

en: Christmas is one of the most important holidays of Christianity, and is celebrated as the birthday of Jesus.
sg: Noël ayeke oko na popo ti amatanga so ayeke ngangu na kundu ti a chrétien nga na akpa matanga ngu ti dungo Jésus.

en: Many of the traditions surrounding the holiday have been adopted also by non-believers in Christian countries and non-Christians around the world.
sg: Angobo mingi ayeke na popo ti matanga azo so ayeke chrétien pepe ala sara ni kue na akodoro ti chrétien nga na ti chrétien pepe na yati dunia kue.

en: There's a tradition to pass the Easter night awake at some exposed point to see the sunrise.
sg: Ayeke na ngobo so atene mo pe ti lango pepe na bi ti Pâques na ndo ti le ti zo ndali ti baa londongo ti la.

en: There are of course Christian theological explanations for this tradition, but it may well be a pre-Christian Spring and Fertility ritual.
sg: Ayeke tatene biani na atene ti hingango ti Nzapa ti chrétien na yati a ngobo so, me a pe ti duti sandaga ti zo so a de ala ga chrétien pepe na ngoi ti Printemps nga na Warango gbati aye.

en: More traditional churches often hold an Easter Vigil on Saturday night during the Easter weekend, with the congregations often breaking into celebration at the stroke of midnight to celebrate Christ's resurrection.
sg: Ada ti Nzapa so ngobo ti ala aninga ala ke sara mingi mtanga ti Pâques na Lapôso ti lakui na yenga ti Pâques, kundu ti azo ti Nzapa ala ke bungbi tere ndo oko ti sara matanga na bêbï ti gonda londongo ti Christ.

en: All animals that originally arrived in the islands came here either by swimming, flying or floating.
sg: Anyama kue so si a si kozo na ndo ti azûâ aga ge na lege ti ngu, a huru wala a tambela gi na ndoti guengo ti ngu.

en: Due to the long distance from the continent mammals were unable to make the journey making the giant tortoise the primary grazing animal in the Galapagos.
sg: Ndali ti yongoro lege ti Kota ndo, Anyama a wara ngangu ti sara gue gene pepe, ni la kota bakongo a ga nyama gi oko ti tengo pere na Galapagos.

en: Since the arrival of man to the Galapagos, many mammals have been introduced including goats, horses, cows, rats, cats and dogs.
sg: Londo na gango ti zo na Galapagos, anyama mingi a li nda da, tongana angasa, ambarata, adeku, anyau nga na ambo.

en: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic areas in the winter you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun doesn't rise above the horizon.
sg: Tongana mo gue baa ando ti arctiques wala antarctiques na ngoi so de asara mingi, moyeke lango na lakui ti polaire, ye so atene la a londo na nduzu ti sese pepe.

en: This offers a good opportunity to see the Aurora borealis, as the sky will be dark more or less around the clock.
sg: Ayeke mu nzoni lege ti baa a Aurores boréales, ndali ti nduzu ayeke voko ahon wala kete angbonga 24 na ndo ti 24.

en: As the areas are sparsely populated, and light pollution therefore often not a problem, you will also be able to enjoy the stars.
sg: Ndani so si azo angba mingi pepe na ando nga na bubango a ndo ayeke mbeni kpale pepe, mo pe ti mu tango ti baa atongoro.

en: Japanese work culture is more hierarchical and formal that what Westerners may be used to.
sg: A kete mara nde nde ti kua ti zo ti Japon ayeke na lege ni nga na lege ti ndia apka ye so azo ti poto a pe ti sara lakue lakue.

en: Suits are standard business attire, and coworkers call each other by their family names or by job titles.
sg: Akazaka ayeke abongo ti buze zo a hinga nga na azo ti kua a mu iri na yani ndali ti sema wala ndali ti kua so ala ngba sara.

en: Workplace harmony is crucial, emphasizing group effort rather than praising individual accomplishments.
sg: Mango tere na ndo ti kua ayeke ngangu, kua a baa ngangu ti kundu ti azo me konda ti kua ti zo oko pepe.

en: Workers must often get their superiors' approval for any decisions they make, and are expected to obey their superiors' instructions without question.
sg: Azo ti kua ala du a ti wara mbeti ti mungo lege ti akotazo ti ala ndali ti ajendo kue ala ke mu ni nga na ala du a ti ye da na atene ti akotazo ti ala san ti tene ala hunda mbeni ye.
